If pasted content comes out wrong, open `/settings` and turn `copyOnSelect` off. You can still select text, but releasing the mouse will no longer copy it.

items.original: Added a `copyOnSelect` setting (default on, toggleable in `/settings`) that controls whether releasing a mouse text-selection auto-copies it to the system clipboard in the TUI's altscreen rendering mode; disable it to stop the automatic copy on release — useful when the auto-copy is unwanted or corrupts certain payloads.

title.zh-TW: 常用串接指令核准一次就夠
title.en: Approve a familiar chained command once, not every time

body.zh-TW: 你每天都要更新專案，輸入 `git fetch && git rebase` 後又得重複核准，流程像同一張通行證每天重新蓋章。現在可以把這條完全相同的串接指令存成「永遠允許」規則。下次再跑同一條指令時，不必再等，權限確認不會重跳。它認的是整串命令，不是看到 `git` 就一概放行；因此常用流程少一步，其他不同命令仍各自檢查。
body.en: When you update a project every day, approving `git fetch && git rebase` again and again feels like getting the same pass stamped from scratch. You can now save that exact chained command as an always-allow rule. The next time you run the identical command, the permission prompt stays away. The rule recognizes the whole chain, not every command that happens to begin with `git`; your routine loses a step while different commands still receive their own check.

items.original: Improved compound-command permissions so an exact chained command (such as `git fetch && git rebase`) can be saved as an allow-always rule and no longer re-prompts on the next identical run.

entries: Improved permission prompts for compound shell commands so the full command is shown when any part of it needs approval.
Improved headless print mode by adding a `cache_read_tokens` field to the `json` and `stream-json` usage output, so non-interactive consumers can attribute prompt-cache hits.
Fixed disabled plugins still running their hooks and contributing other customizations, which could keep a broken hook active and break file-editing tools even after the plugin was turned off.
Fixed MCP OAuth against providers that do not strictly follow the spec (such as Salesforce and Atlassian) by relaxing issuer validation and including the `refresh_token` grant.
Fixed `/btw` failing with a "parent conversation not found" error when used as the very first action in a fresh session.
Fixed clipboard corruption of CJK and other non-ASCII text when copying on Windows.
Fixed print mode (`-p`) sending a prompt before the account-eligibility check finished, which let ineligible accounts bypass the check the interactive UI enforces.

title.zh-TW: 一行串好幾個指令，權限提示不再只給你看一半
title.en: Permission prompts now show the whole compound command

body.zh-TW: 整理一批檔案時，你常會把好幾個動作串成一行指令送出去。以前只要其中一小段需要你點頭，跳出來的權限提示（動手前先問過你的確認視窗）就只顯示那一段，前後做了什麼全藏著不給看——等於在一份只掀開其中一條的合約上簽名。現在只要整串裡有任何一段需要核准，提示會把即將執行的完整指令原封不動攤開，你看得到它前面先做了什麼、後面接著做什麼，再決定要不要放行。
body.en: When you clean up a batch of files, you tend to chain several actions into one shell command. Until now, if a single fragment of that chain needed approval, the permission prompt showed you only that fragment and hid everything around it — rather like being asked to sign a contract with one clause uncovered and the rest under a sheet of paper. Now, whenever any part of a compound command needs approval, the prompt lays out the full command exactly as it will run, so you can see what comes before and after before letting it through.

items.original: Improved permission prompts for compound shell commands so the full command is shown when any part of it needs approval.

title.zh-TW: 沒人盯著的自動模式，補上用量明細與資格把關
title.en: Print mode gains cache accounting and a real eligibility gate

body.zh-TW: 排程在半夜自己跑，沒有人在旁邊看畫面，出了事常常是隔天才發現。這版替 headless print mode（不開視窗、直接把答案輸出的執行方式）補上兩道缺口。一是 `json` 與 `stream-json` 的用量報表多了 `cache_read_tokens` 這個欄位，程式自己就算得出這次有多少文字單位是直接讀暫存拿到的，不必再靠猜。二是用 `-p` 送出提示時，以前不等帳號資格檢查跑完就先發車，讓不符資格的帳號繞過互動介面本來會擋的那道關，現在會等檢查完成才送出。像無人商店，正因為沒有店員在場，收據要印得更清楚，門口的驗證更不能省。
body.en: When you wire the AI into an automated pipeline, nobody is watching the screen, so problems surface only afterwards. This release closes two gaps in headless print mode. First, the `json` and `stream-json` usage output now carries a `cache_read_tokens` field, so a non-interactive consumer can work out how much of the prompt was served from cache and attribute those hits itself. Second, running with `-p` used to send the prompt before the account-eligibility check had finished, which let ineligible accounts slip past the gate the interactive UI enforces; it now waits for the check. An unstaffed shop is exactly the place where the receipt has to be itemised and the door check cannot be skipped.

items.original:
Improved headless print mode by adding a `cache_read_tokens` field to the `json` and `stream-json` usage output, so non-interactive consumers can attribute prompt-cache hits.
Fixed print mode (`-p`) sending a prompt before the account-eligibility check finished, which let ineligible accounts bypass the check the interactive UI enforces.

title.zh-TW: 外掛關掉了，它的掛鉤還在背後動作
title.en: Disabled plugins no longer keep running their hooks

body.zh-TW: 把一個外掛停用，理當它就該完全安靜下來。以前並不是——它的 hook（掛鉤，特定事件一發生就被自動觸發的小程式）照樣在背景執行，它帶進來的其他自訂設定也繼續生效。最難纏的情況是那個掛鉤本身已經壞了：它會一路卡住編輯檔案的工具，而你早就把外掛關了，根本不會回頭懷疑它，只能對著改不動的檔案發呆。現在停用就是真的停用，掛鉤和它夾帶的自訂設定一起下線。像員工離職卻沒繳回門禁卡，人不在了，卡還刷得開門，這次是連卡一起收回來。
body.en: Turn a plugin off and you would expect it to fall silent. It did not. Its hooks kept firing in the background, and the other customizations it brought along stayed in effect. The nastiest version of this was a hook that was already broken: it would jam the file-editing tools, and since you had disabled the plugin long ago, it never occurred to you to suspect it — you just sat there wondering why nothing would save. Disabling now really disables: the hooks and everything else the plugin contributed go quiet together. An employee leaves but keeps the door badge; the person is gone and the badge still opens the door. This time the badge comes back too.

items.original: Fixed disabled plugins still running their hooks and contributing other customizations, which could keep a broken hook active and break file-editing tools even after the plugin was turned off.

title.zh-TW: 接 Salesforce、Atlassian 的授權不再卡在規格差異
title.en: MCP OAuth now works with providers that bend the spec

body.zh-TW: 公司拿 Salesforce 管客戶、拿 Atlassian 那套管專案，你想讓 AI 直接讀得到裡面的資料，卻總是卡在授權那一步。問題出在 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 接上外部工具的協定）走的 OAuth 授權流程：這兩家的實作沒有完全照規範走，發行方資訊對不上，驗證就直接判失敗。現在比對發行方的條件放寬了，也把 `refresh_token` 這種續期方式一併帶上，授權到期時能自己換一張新的，不用你重登一次。像出國帶轉接頭，各國插座本來就不完全一樣，與其要求對方改插座，不如自己帶一個接得上的頭。
body.en: Your company runs customers through Salesforce and projects through Atlassian, you want the AI to read from them directly, and you get stuck at authorization. The culprit is the OAuth flow behind MCP, the protocol that connects the AI to external tools: neither provider follows the spec to the letter, the issuer details fail to line up, and validation rejects the whole thing. Issuer validation is now relaxed, and the `refresh_token` grant is included, so an expiring authorization renews itself instead of sending you back to the login screen. It is the travel adapter approach: sockets genuinely differ between countries, and bringing a plug that fits beats demanding the country rewire.

items.original: Fixed MCP OAuth against providers that do not strictly follow the spec (such as Salesforce and Atlassian) by relaxing issuer validation and including the `refresh_token` grant.

title.zh-TW: 新對話第一句就打 `/btw`，不再說找不到上一則
title.en: `/btw` works as the very first action in a fresh session

body.zh-TW: 開一個全新的工作階段，什麼都還沒問，直接打 `/btw` 想先補一句題外話——以前這會當場失敗，丟回一句「找不到父對話」（parent conversation，指這句題外話原本該掛上去的那一則）。這種錯最讓人愣住：明明什麼都還沒做錯，第一個動作就撞牆，而且訊息講的是一個你根本沒聽過的東西。現在把它當開場第一個動作用，也能正常運作了。像剛拆封的筆記本，你想在第一頁就貼張便利貼，總不能因為前面沒有頁面而不讓你貼。
body.en: You open a fresh session, ask nothing yet, and type `/btw` to drop in an aside first — and it used to fail on the spot with "parent conversation not found", the parent being the turn the aside was meant to hang off. Errors like this are the most disorienting kind: you have done nothing wrong, the very first thing you try hits a wall, and the message names something you have never heard of. Using it as the opening action now works. You have just unwrapped a notebook and want a sticky note on page one; the absence of earlier pages is no reason to refuse.

items.original: Fixed `/btw` failing with a "parent conversation not found" error when used as the very first action in a fresh session.

title.zh-TW: Windows 上複製中日韓文字不再變亂碼
title.en: Copying CJK text on Windows no longer corrupts it

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 上複製一段中文、日文或韓文，貼出來變成一排問號和方框——這件事以前真的會發生。毛病出在送進剪貼簿的那一刻：ASCII（大致只涵蓋英文字母、數字與常見符號的老字碼表）以外的字元沒有被正確編碼，字在搬運途中就已經碎了，貼到哪裡都拼不回來。你想把一段錯誤訊息複製給同事看，對方收到的是一團看不懂的符號，只好請你截圖重來。這版把編碼修好了，複製什麼就貼出什麼。像影印機明明吃得下這張紙，印出來卻缺了半篇字，這次換掉的是機器本身。
body.en: Copy a line of Chinese, Japanese or Korean on Windows and paste out a row of question marks and empty boxes — that really did happen. The damage occurred at the moment the text entered the clipboard: non-ASCII characters were not encoded correctly, so the characters were already broken in transit and no destination could reassemble them. You copy an error message to show a colleague, they receive a blob of symbols, and you end up sending a screenshot instead. The encoding is fixed: what you copy is what you paste. A photocopier that accepts the page but prints half the characters as noise does not need better paper; it needs a new machine.

items.original: Fixed clipboard corruption of CJK and other non-ASCII text when copying on Windows.

entries: Custom Agents (Markdown Format). Added support for defining custom agents using Markdown files (`agent.md`) with YAML frontmatter and H1-delimited system prompts. Markdown agents support `mainAgent`, `subagent`, `hidden`, `inheritMcp`, and `commandExecutionPolicy` frontmatter fields for fine-grained control over agent behavior. Dynamically defined subagents (via `define_subagent`) now also write Markdown format so they resolve correctly on external builds.
Added an optional index argument to `/copy` so `/copy <n>` copies the n-th most recent response to the clipboard, while `/copy` and `/copy 1` still copy the latest.

Improved `/codesearch` to render results progressively as they stream in, showing a live count while loading and letting you cancel an in-flight search with `Esc` instead of blocking until the whole search finishes.

Improved default file access by granting read access to the system temporary directory out of the box, resolved correctly per platform, so agents no longer trigger permission prompts when reading temporary files.
Improved support for markdown-based custom agents so custom agent management and selection behave more consistently.
Improved customization discovery by sorting rules and discovered paths deterministically, preventing unstable prompt ordering and needless prompt-cache misses.
Improved overall reliability and stability across the CLI with additional hardening and fixes for intermittent failures in background tasks, print mode, and interactive flows.
Fixed switching from a custom agent back to the default agent via `/agents`, which previously failed silently and left the conversation stuck on the custom agent's persona.
Fixed a crash when a command was blocked by sandbox permissions before its output was captured, and cleaned up the permission approval and denial messages.
Fixed the artifact viewer emitting garbage escape bytes when cycling to image mode on terminals that are detected but cannot actually render Kitty graphics, such as iTerm2.
Fixed the first keystroke (such as `Esc`) being dropped when opening the first artifact view on some non-Kitty terminals.
Fixed conversation jitter and a stranded input box during streaming so transient markdown reflow no longer shifts the pending line and input box upward.
Fixed print mode (`-p`) surfacing the real conversation-creation failure instead of a misleading "no active conversation" error.
Fixed the message list dropping its header when rewinding or resetting conversation steps.
Fixed a background auto-updater double-spawn race where two processes could each spawn an updater within a single update window.
Fixed sandbox error reporting so blocked actions are recorded even when the network proxy is disabled.
Fixed the screen going blank after the authentication page.

Fixed the `ctrl+b` shortcut being hardcoded to background shell commands even when none were running, so a remapped `ctrl+b` is now respected whenever there are no running shell commands in the conversation.

title.zh-TW: 自訂 Agent 改用 Markdown，角色切換不再卡住
title.en: Custom agents move to Markdown, and switching roles no longer gets stuck

body.zh-TW: 想替 AI 配一位專門校稿或查資料的助手，現在可以用 `agent.md` 這種 Markdown 檔（用標題與一般文字寫內容的純文字格式）來定義 custom agent（自訂 Agent，替 AI 指定另一套角色與做事規則）。檔案開頭的 YAML frontmatter（放在檔案開頭、用欄位寫設定的區塊）可決定它是主助手、子助手、是否隱藏、是否沿用 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定），以及可否執行指令；用 H1 標題也能切出給它的系統提示詞。這像替不同職務做名牌和工作守則；動態建立的子助手也會拿到同款名牌，搬到外部版本仍認得出來。`/agents` 從自訂角色切回預設角色的失敗問題也修好，不會表面切換、其實還困在舊人格。
body.en: If you want an AI helper dedicated to proofreading or research, you can now define a custom agent with an `agent.md` Markdown file: ordinary text with headings. Its YAML frontmatter, a settings block at the very top of the file, can say whether it is the main agent, a subagent, hidden, inherits MCP (the protocol that lets AI connect to outside tools), or may run commands. Think of it as a job badge plus work rules for each role. Dynamically created subagents now get the same badge, so external builds recognize them too. `/agents` also correctly returns from a custom role to the default one instead of appearing to switch while leaving the conversation in the old persona.

items.original:
Custom Agents (Markdown Format). Added support for defining custom agents using Markdown files (`agent.md`) with YAML frontmatter and H1-delimited system prompts. Markdown agents support `mainAgent`, `subagent`, `hidden`, `inheritMcp`, and `commandExecutionPolicy` frontmatter fields for fine-grained control over agent behavior. Dynamically defined subagents (via `define_subagent`) now also write Markdown format so they resolve correctly on external builds.
Improved support for markdown-based custom agents so custom agent management and selection behave more consistently.
Fixed switching from a custom agent back to the default agent via `/agents`, which previously failed silently and left the conversation stuck on the custom agent's persona.

title.zh-TW: `/copy` 能挑選較早的回答
title.en: `/copy` can now pick an earlier answer

body.zh-TW: 剛看完幾輪回答，才發現想貼出去的是前一則？`/copy 2` 現在會把倒數第二則回答複製到剪貼簿（暫時放著、可貼到別處的地方）。數字 `n` 代表第 n 則最近回答；不加數字的 `/copy` 和 `/copy 1` 仍是最新一則。你可直接把那段貼進訊息、文件或筆記。像翻相簿時直接抽出前一張照片，不必先把最新照片複製走，再回頭手動選文字。
body.en: Finished a few rounds of answers and realized the one you need to paste is the previous one? `/copy 2` now copies the second-most-recent response to the clipboard, the temporary place from which you paste elsewhere. The number `n` means the n-th most recent response; plain `/copy` and `/copy 1` still mean the latest. It is like pulling the prior photo from an album directly instead of copying the newest photo first and then selecting old text by hand.

items.original: Added an optional index argument to `/copy` so `/copy <n>` copies the n-th most recent response to the clipboard, while `/copy` and `/copy 1` still copy the latest.

title.zh-TW: 程式碼搜尋邊找邊顯示，也能按 Esc 停下
title.en: Code search shows results as it works, and Esc can stop it

body.zh-TW: 在大專案裡用 `/codesearch` 找一個函式名稱時，不必盯著空畫面等全部結果。搜尋結果現在會隨資料到達逐步顯示，還會告訴你目前找到了幾筆；你可以先從已出現的檔案判斷是否找對地方。如果方向不對，按 `Esc` 就能取消還在跑的搜尋。這像在倉庫找貨時，搬運員一找到一箱就先送到你面前，數量也一路更新；你發現拿錯訂單，隨時喊停即可。
body.en: When you use `/codesearch` to find a function name in a large project, you no longer have to stare at an empty screen until every result arrives. Matches now appear progressively, with a live count; if you searched in the wrong direction, `Esc` cancels the search while it is still running. It is like a warehouse worker bringing each box to you as soon as it is found while updating the tally, and stopping the moment you realize it is the wrong order.

items.original: Improved `/codesearch` to render results progressively as they stream in, showing a live count while loading and letting you cancel an in-flight search with `Esc` instead of blocking until the whole search finishes.

title.zh-TW: 讀取暫存檔不再先跳權限詢問
title.en: Reading temporary files no longer starts with a permission prompt

body.zh-TW: 你請 Agent 看剛下載或剛產生的暫存檔時，現在通常不會先被權限視窗打斷。CLI 已預設給 system temporary directory（系統暫存目錄，程式短暫放檔案的地方）讀取權限，並依 Windows、macOS、Linux 各自的位置正確處理。它只多開了「看」的門，沒有多開修改或刪除的門；像飯店櫃台直接給你行李寄放區的查看證，讓助手能讀到它剛放進去的收據，不必每次先打電話確認。
body.en: When you ask an agent to inspect a file it just downloaded or generated temporarily, a permission dialog usually will not interrupt first. The CLI now grants read access by default to the system temporary directory, the place where programs briefly park files, and resolves that location correctly on each platform. This opens only the door to look, not to edit or delete. It is like a hotel desk giving you a viewing pass for the luggage area so the helper can read the receipt it just put there without calling for approval every time.

items.original: Improved default file access by granting read access to the system temporary directory out of the box, resolved correctly per platform, so agents no longer trigger permission prompts when reading temporary files.

title.zh-TW: 自訂規則排序固定，快取不再白白失效
title.en: Custom rules keep a stable order, avoiding needless cache misses

body.zh-TW: 同一套自訂規則和路徑，現在每次被找到時都會排成固定順序。以前順序偶爾飄動，即使內容沒變，送進 prompt cache（提示詞快取，把已處理過的指示暫存再利用）看起來也像另一份資料，得重新處理。這次把排序定下來，讓快取能認出「還是原來那張清單」，少做無謂的重複準備。像把食譜卡永遠照同一順序放回抽屜，廚師下次一眼就知道沒換菜單，不必重新備料。
body.en: The same set of custom rules and discovered paths now arrives in a fixed order every time. Previously, the order could drift; even unchanged content then looked new to the prompt cache, which temporarily stores processed instructions for reuse, and had to be handled again. Stable sorting lets the cache recognize the same list. It is like returning recipe cards to a drawer in the same order, so the cook sees at once that the menu has not changed and need not prep everything again.

items.original: Improved customization discovery by sorting rules and discovered paths deterministically, preventing unstable prompt ordering and needless prompt-cache misses.

title.zh-TW: 終端機畫面修順，登入後不再一片空白
title.en: Terminal views are smoother, with no blank screen after sign-in

body.zh-TW: 螢幕上的小毛病，這版一次掃掉好幾個。切到圖片 artifact viewer（成品檢視器，用來看 AI 產出檔案的畫面）時，iTerm2 這類偵測到但不能畫 Kitty 圖形的終端機，不會再噴出亂碼；第一次開啟檢視器也不會吞掉你按的 `Esc`。回答串流時，Markdown（用簡單符號排版的文字格式）重新排版不再把輸入框往上推得抖動；倒帶或重設步驟後，訊息列表標題仍在。登入驗證頁結束後也不會只剩空白畫面。像電影院換幕時，以前字幕、座椅和片頭偶爾各自滑走；現在換場仍把畫面與你的按鍵留在該在的位置。
body.en: Several screen glitches disappear together in this release. When switching an image artifact viewer, the view used for AI-generated files, iTerm2-like terminals that are detected but cannot draw Kitty graphics no longer spew garbage characters; the first viewer opening also stops swallowing your `Esc` key. During response streaming, Markdown, a plain-text formatting language, no longer reflows in a way that jitters the input box upward, and the message-list header survives rewinding or resetting steps. The screen also no longer goes blank after the sign-in page. Like a cinema changing scenes: subtitles, seats, and the opening title used to slide away separately; now the scene changes while the image and your keypress stay put.

items.original:
Fixed the artifact viewer emitting garbage escape bytes when cycling to image mode on terminals that are detected but cannot actually render Kitty graphics, such as iTerm2.
Fixed the first keystroke (such as `Esc`) being dropped when opening the first artifact view on some non-Kitty terminals.
Fixed conversation jitter and a stranded input box during streaming so transient markdown reflow no longer shifts the pending line and input box upward.
Fixed the message list dropping its header when rewinding or resetting conversation steps.
Fixed the screen going blank after the authentication page.

title.zh-TW: 背景更新與受阻指令的錯誤資訊更可靠
title.en: Background updates and blocked-command errors are more reliable

body.zh-TW: 程式卡住時，最怕它只丟一句無關的錯誤。print mode（列印模式，用 `-p` 把回答直接輸出、不開互動介面的模式）建立對話失敗時，現在會顯示真正的建立失敗原因，不再假稱「沒有啟用中的對話」。sandbox（沙箱，把程式關在受限空間裡執行的保護機制）先擋住指令時，即使 network proxy（網路代理，代替程式轉送網路請求的中介）停用，也會留下受阻紀錄，核准與拒絕的訊息也整理得更清楚。背景自動更新器則修掉雙重啟動競賽：同一個更新時段不會兩個行程各自再叫一個更新器。沒有正在執行的背景 shell 指令時，你重新綁定的 `ctrl+b` 快捷鍵也會生效。像值班室終於寫對事故單，也確保同一班只派一位維修員出車。
body.en: When a program fails, the worst outcome is an error that points somewhere else. If print mode, the `-p` mode that outputs an answer without an interactive interface, cannot create a conversation, it now shows the real creation failure rather than claiming there is no active conversation. When the sandbox, the protective restricted space for running programs, blocks a command first, it records that block even with the network proxy off; approval and denial messages are cleaner too. The background auto-updater also fixes a double-spawn race, so two processes cannot each launch an updater in the same update window. When no background shell commands are running, a remapped `ctrl+b` shortcut is now respected. It is like a control room finally filing the right incident report and sending only one repair crew for one shift.

items.original:
Improved overall reliability and stability across the CLI with additional hardening and fixes for intermittent failures in background tasks, print mode, and interactive flows.
Fixed a crash when a command was blocked by sandbox permissions before its output was captured, and cleaned up the permission approval and denial messages.
Fixed print mode (`-p`) surfacing the real conversation-creation failure instead of a misleading "no active conversation" error.
Fixed a background auto-updater double-spawn race where two processes could each spawn an updater within a single update window.
Fixed sandbox error reporting so blocked actions are recorded even when the network proxy is disabled.
Fixed the `ctrl+b` shortcut being hardcoded to background shell commands even when none were running, so a remapped `ctrl+b` is now respected whenever there are no running shell commands in the conversation.

entries: Added a `/effort` command to view and change the current model's reasoning effort, with a left/right timeline-gauge picker and a direct `/effort <level>` form so you can trade latency for depth on the fly.
Added an `--effort` flag to select a model's reasoning-effort variant when launching the CLI.
Added stable, user-facing model slugs that appear in the `/model` picker and are accepted by `--model`, so you can pin a specific model reliably across sessions.
Added a `model` option to custom agent frontmatter so an agent runs at a chosen model tier (such as `flash` or `pro`) when invoked as a subagent, defaulting to `inherit` (the parent's model).

Redesigned the `/model` picker to group models by their base model and choose reasoning effort from a timeline gauge navigable with Left and Right, and added an effort badge to the status line for models that expose multiple effort variants.

Improved the `/settings` (`/config`) panel by making it a bounded, scrollable list so it renders correctly in short terminals instead of overflowing, and stopped it from flickering when opening and closing dropdowns.

Improved background-task reliability by moving long-running work onto a shared lifecycle with deterministic startup and shutdown and panic-safe launching, so a failure in one background task no longer disrupts the session and pending analytics are flushed on exit instead of dropped.
Improved responsiveness of bursty background refreshes by coalescing rapid repeated triggers into a single run, cutting redundant work.
Fixed a crash when triggering Authenticate on a remote MCP server in the `/mcp` panel.
Fixed MCP tool results containing embedded resources being silently dropped, so text and inline media returned by MCP servers now surface in the conversation.
Fixed permission checks splitting a single command into a pipeline when an argument contained quoted shell metacharacters (such as `--grep="a|b"`), which caused spurious permission prompts.
Fixed the file-view and file-search tools failing with invalid-UTF-8 errors when a multi-byte character was split at a truncation boundary.
Fixed a data race when collecting customization rules by guarding the shared structures.
Added support for stacking multiple leading slash commands in a single prompt, so a chain like `/plan /grill-me <prompt>` parses, activates, and renders every command in the order you typed them.
Improved scrolling in the `/diff` viewer so paging through a diff no longer jitters or pushes the status line off the screen when lines wrap or comments expand.
Fixed custom agents that declare `subagent: false` still appearing in the available-subagents list and being invocable as subagents.
Fixed headless (`-p` / `--print`) runs so they now honor persisted `settings.json` policies, including `permissions`, file access, sandbox mode, auto-execution, and artifact review.
Fixed `/btw` side-questions leaking into the conversation list as duplicate entries that carried the parent conversation's title.
Fixed the prompt to honor a custom Enter binding to `prompt.insert_newline`, so a remapped Enter inserts a newline instead of submitting.
Fixed eligibility error messages so the CLI shows the real reason again instead of defaulting to a generic "unknown reason".

title.zh-TW: 模型選擇多了深淺旋鈕，也能替代理指定等級
title.en: Model choice gains a depth dial and agent-specific tiers

body.zh-TW: 趕著回覆訊息時，你會想要快；遇到棘手問題時，則願意多等一下換更深的推理。新的 `/effort` 指令把這個取捨做成時間軸儀表，可左右選擇，也能直接輸入等級；啟動 CLI 時則用 `--effort` 選定。`/model` 現在用穩定的 model slug（模型的固定代號）列出選項，跨工作階段也能可靠指定同一款模型。你替 custom agent（自訂代理，預先寫好工作規則的小幫手）加上 `model` 後，叫它當子代理時可跑 flash 或 pro；沒指定便沿用父代理。像相機不只選鏡頭，還能轉快門：快拍或細拍，由你在當下決定。
body.en: When a reply is urgent, you want speed; when a problem is thorny, you may accept a wait for deeper reasoning. The new `/effort` command turns that tradeoff into a left/right timeline gauge, and also accepts a level directly; `--effort` makes the choice when launching the CLI. `/model` now shows stable model slugs, fixed names you can reliably reuse across sessions. A custom agent, a helper with prewritten instructions, can now declare its own `model`: as a subagent it can use a tier such as flash or pro, otherwise it inherits its parent’s model. It is like setting both a camera lens and shutter speed: choose quick or deliberate for task in front of you.

items.original:
Added a `/effort` command to view and change the current model's reasoning effort, with a left/right timeline-gauge picker and a direct `/effort <level>` form so you can trade latency for depth on the fly.
Added an `--effort` flag to select a model's reasoning-effort variant when launching the CLI.
Added stable, user-facing model slugs that appear in the `/model` picker and are accepted by `--model`, so you can pin a specific model reliably across sessions.
Added a `model` option to custom agent frontmatter so an agent runs at a chosen model tier (such as `flash` or `pro`) when invoked as a subagent, defaulting to `inherit` (the parent's model).
Redesigned the `/model` picker to group models by their base model and choose reasoning effort from a timeline gauge navigable with Left and Right, and added an effort badge to the status line for models that expose multiple effort variants.

title.zh-TW: 短終端機也看得清設定，檢視差異不再把畫面推歪
title.en: Settings fit short terminals and diff viewing stays steady

body.zh-TW: 筆電分割畫面時，設定清單不該像過長的海報從視窗底下溢出去。`/settings` 或 `/config` 現在是有邊界、可捲動的清單，開關下拉選單也不再閃爍。你查看程式修改處時，`/diff` 檢視器在換頁、長行折行或展開留言後，不會抖動，更不會把狀態列擠出螢幕。連輸入框也聽得懂你的重綁 Enter：若綁到 `prompt.insert_newline`，按下去會換行而非送出。這些改動像把凌亂書桌換成有抽屜的工作台；內容還是那些內容，手邊位置終於穩了。
body.en: On a split laptop screen, a settings list should not spill below the window like an overlong poster. `/settings` and `/config` are now bounded, scrollable lists, and their dropdowns no longer flicker. While reviewing code changes, the `/diff` viewer no longer jitters or pushes the status line offscreen when you page, wrapped lines appear, or comments expand. The prompt also honors a remapped Enter: if it is bound to `prompt.insert_newline`, it inserts a line break instead of submitting. It is like replacing a messy desk with a workbench full of drawers: same tools, but they stay where your hands expect them.

items.original:
Improved the `/settings` (`/config`) panel by making it a bounded, scrollable list so it renders correctly in short terminals instead of overflowing, and stopped it from flickering when opening and closing dropdowns.
Improved scrolling in the `/diff` viewer so paging through a diff no longer jitters or pushes the status line off the screen when lines wrap or comments expand.
Fixed the prompt to honor a custom Enter binding to `prompt.insert_newline`, so a remapped Enter inserts a newline instead of submitting.

title.zh-TW: 背景工作不再一處失火、整場陪葬
title.en: Background work becomes isolated, orderly, and less wasteful

body.zh-TW: 讓 CLI 在背景慢慢更新資料時，最怕其中一件小事出錯，整個工作階段跟著亂掉。現在長時間背景任務共用同一套生命週期，啟動與關閉都有固定順序，啟動時也能安全面對 panic（程式遇到嚴重錯誤而中斷）；單一任務失敗不再拖垮整場，離開前待送的分析資料也會送完。短時間內連續觸發更新，則會合併成一次，少做重複工作。收集自訂規則時的 data race（多個工作同時碰同份資料造成結果不穩）也補上保護。像廚房把各道菜分到獨立爐火，並把連按三次的叫餐鈴合成一張單；一口鍋燒焦，不會讓整間餐廳停擺。
body.en: When the CLI refreshes data in the background, one small failure should not scramble the whole session. Long-running background tasks now share one lifecycle, with deterministic start and shutdown and panic-safe launching; one failed task no longer disrupts the session, and pending analytics are flushed before exit. Several refresh triggers arriving in a burst are coalesced into one run instead of repeating work. A data race, where concurrent work touches shared data unpredictably, is also guarded while customization rules are collected. It is like giving each dish in a kitchen its own burner and turning three rapid bell rings into one order: one burnt pan does not close the restaurant.

items.original:
Improved background-task reliability by moving long-running work onto a shared lifecycle with deterministic startup and shutdown and panic-safe launching, so a failure in one background task no longer disrupts the session and pending analytics are flushed on exit instead of dropped.
Improved responsiveness of bursty background refreshes by coalescing rapid repeated triggers into a single run, cutting redundant work.
Fixed a data race when collecting customization rules by guarding the shared structures.

title.zh-TW: MCP 登入不當機，伺服器回傳內容不再消失
title.en: MCP authentication stays up and returned content reaches chat

body.zh-TW: 你在 `/mcp` 面板替遠端 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器按 Authenticate 時，現在不會再把 CLI 按到當機。更重要的是，MCP 工具回傳的 embedded resources（嵌入式資源，文字或內嵌媒體等隨結果附上的內容）以前會被悄悄丟掉，現在會出現在對話裡。也就是說，接上外部工具後，登入這扇門能打開，工具端帶回來的說明或圖片也不會留在門外。像快遞站以前辦證時會關門，包裹裡附的文件還會被抽走；現在櫃台照常辦理，附檔也完整交到你手上。
body.en: Pressing Authenticate for a remote MCP server in the `/mcp` panel no longer crashes the CLI. More importantly, embedded resources, extra text or inline media carried inside an MCP tool result, used to be silently discarded; they now appear in the conversation. In other words, once you connect an external tool through MCP, the authentication door opens and its explanation or image can come through with it. It is like a parcel counter that once shut down while checking your ID and removed documents from packages; now the counter stays open and every enclosure reaches your hands.

items.original:
Fixed a crash when triggering Authenticate on a remote MCP server in the `/mcp` panel.
Fixed MCP tool results containing embedded resources being silently dropped, so text and inline media returned by MCP servers now surface in the conversation.

title.zh-TW: 指令判讀與檔案搜尋更耐髒資料，錯誤也說人話
title.en: Command checks and file search handle awkward input more safely

body.zh-TW: 你下 `--grep="a|b"` 這類指令時，管線符號明明只是引號裡的參數，權限檢查卻曾誤以為你真要建立 pipeline（管線，把一個指令輸出交給下一個指令的串接），跳出多餘提示；現在能正確看懂。檢視或搜尋檔案時，若多位元字元剛好被截在中間，也不再因 invalid UTF-8 而失敗。資格不符時，CLI 也重新顯示真正原因，不再只說「unknown reason」。這像機場安檢終於會分辨行李標籤上的豎線和危險物，掃描到半截外文字也不會當成壞行李；拒絕登機時，還會告訴你缺的是哪份證件。
body.en: With a command such as `--grep="a|b"`, a pipe character inside a quoted argument is not a pipeline, a chain that passes one command’s output to another. Permission checks used to misread it and ask unnecessarily; now they interpret it correctly. File viewing and search also stop failing with invalid UTF-8 when a multibyte character is cut at a truncation boundary. And when you are not eligible, the CLI again shows the real reason rather than “unknown reason.” It is like airport screening that can distinguish a vertical mark on a luggage tag from a hazardous item, and can explain which document is missing when it cannot let you board.

items.original:
Fixed permission checks splitting a single command into a pipeline when an argument contained quoted shell metacharacters (such as `--grep="a|b"`), which caused spurious permission prompts.
Fixed the file-view and file-search tools failing with invalid-UTF-8 errors when a multi-byte character was split at a truncation boundary.
Fixed eligibility error messages so the CLI shows the real reason again instead of defaulting to a generic "unknown reason".

title.zh-TW: 多指令能連著下，代理與無頭執行也各守界線
title.en: Chained commands, agents, and headless runs now follow their intended rules

body.zh-TW: 規劃完還想立刻請它挑毛病？現在同一句可排 `/plan /grill-me <prompt>`，每個開頭斜線指令會依輸入順序解析、啟用並顯示。custom agent 若明確寫 `subagent: false`，也不會再混進可呼叫的子代理清單。用 `-p` 或 `--print` 跑 headless（無頭模式，沒有終端機視窗／視覺介面的執行模式）時，已儲存的 `settings.json` 政策終於會生效，包括權限、檔案存取、sandbox mode（沙盒模式，把程式限制在安全範圍內的執行方式）、自動執行與成品審查。`/btw` 的岔題也不再複製成另一筆同標題對話。像火車站的轉乘牌：能依序換線，但標著不接客的月台不會被派車，沒有站務員的夜車仍照既定規則行駛。
body.en: Finished planning and want an immediate critique? One prompt can now begin `/plan /grill-me <prompt>`; each leading slash command is parsed, activated, and displayed in typed order. A custom agent explicitly marked `subagent: false` no longer sneaks into the callable-subagent list. Headless runs, execution through `-p` or `--print` without a terminal window, now honor saved `settings.json` policies: permissions, file access, sandbox mode, auto-execution, and artifact review. A `/btw` side question also stops making a duplicate conversation with its parent’s title. It is like a station transfer board: you can change lines in order, closed platforms are not assigned trains, and an unattended night train still follows its rules.

items.original:
Added support for stacking multiple leading slash commands in a single prompt, so a chain like `/plan /grill-me <prompt>` parses, activates, and renders every command in the order you typed them.
Fixed custom agents that declare `subagent: false` still appearing in the available-subagents list and being invocable as subagents.
Fixed headless (`-p` / `--print`) runs so they now honor persisted `settings.json` policies, including `permissions`, file access, sandbox mode, auto-execution, and artifact review.
Fixed `/btw` side-questions leaking into the conversation list as duplicate entries that carried the parent conversation's title.

entries: Added a `/codesearch` command (aliases `/cs` and `/search`) to interactively search code across your workspace, interpreting queries as regex by default with `-F`/`--literal` for exact matching and `f:`/`file:` globs to include or exclude paths.

Added copy-on-select in no-flickering mode so dragging highlights text and releasing the mouse copies the ANSI-stripped selection to the clipboard, and hides the virtual scrollbar so it no longer interferes with copying multi-line output.
Added an indicator at each context-compaction boundary so you can see where earlier compaction happened.
Improved interactive startup latency by loading skills asynchronously so the CLI no longer blocks on a synchronous, filesystem-heavy skill-discovery pass during bring-up.
Improved eligibility error handling by showing errors with a verification URL inline in the input loop instead of stacking them above the screen.
Improved customization loading latency for skills, rules, agents, and hooks by consolidating directory walks and caching filesystem lookups to cut redundant I/O during discovery.
Removed the padding spaces around inline code for tighter rendering.

Fixed code-block corruption where `$..$` math expansion desynced from the Markdown parser and mangled fenced shell snippets such as `git fetch "$GIT_REMOTE"` by detecting fenced code blocks line-by-line.

Fixed headless (`-p`) runs hanging or silently auto-approving tools that require a permission confirmation, so the CLI now soft-denies such tools and prints a stderr notice naming the allow-rule needed to permit them.
Fixed outside-of-workspace file writes being incorrectly auto-approved in always-proceed mode.
Fixed high CPU and unbounded render cost on large conversations in no-flickering mode by making index rebuilds idempotent so the conversation index converges instead of growing on every rebuild.
Fixed lingering artifact comments after dismissing the artifact detail view and corrected no-flickering-mode row math so the status line renders correctly within the viewport.

Fixed repeated sign-in prompts on Linux caused by the OS keyring: the CLI now bypasses the keyring when no D-Bus session bus is present (headless hosts and containers), skips it for an hour after a timeout, and uses longer keyring timeouts so a slow-but-successful credential read is no longer cut short and forced into a fresh login.
Fixed MCP servers hanging the agent indefinitely when a server never responds by bounding connection, tool-listing, and per-tool-call attempts with timeouts.
Fixed conversations breaking after certain tool calls, which previously corrupted the conversation history and blocked all further responses.
Fixed customization rules being loaded twice when a rules directory is reachable through a symlink.

title.zh-TW: 找程式碼有專屬指令，排版錯亂與報錯畫面一次修好
title.en: A dedicated code search command, plus fixes for garbled formatting and intrusive errors

body.zh-TW: 你能用全新的 `/codesearch`（或 `/cs`）指令快速翻找整個專案的程式碼了。它預設支援正規表達式（regex，一種用符號匹配字串的進階語法），你也能加上 `-F` 進行字字精準的比對，甚至用 `f:` 來過濾特定檔案。在介面體驗上，系統排版變聰明了：它會明確畫出一條線，告訴你先前的對話在哪裡被壓縮過（context-compaction，把舊記憶摺疊起來省空間的功能）；行內程式碼周圍多餘的空白被移除了；含有錢字號的終端機指令，也不會再被 Markdown 解析器誤認成數學公式而變成亂碼。此外，遇到 eligibility error（資格驗證錯誤）時，錯誤訊息和驗證網址現在會乖乖安插在輸入框裡，不會再把你的畫面往上頂。就像你買了一個新書櫃，不只附贈了超強的檢索系統幫你精準找書，還順手把原本會爆出櫃子的通知單好好夾在書頁裡、撫平書本間的折頁。
body.en: You can now quickly dig through your entire project's code using the new `/codesearch` (or `/cs`) command. It interprets your queries as regular expressions (regex, an advanced syntax for pattern matching) by default, but you can use `-F` for strictly literal matches and filter specific files using `f:` globs. Visually, the interface has grown smarter: it now draws a clear indicator line to show exactly where earlier conversation history was squeezed down (context-compaction, the feature that folds old memories to save space); extra padding spaces around inline code have been stripped away; and shell commands containing dollar signs will no longer be mistaken for math formulas. Also, when an eligibility error occurs, the message and verification URL now sit politely inline in your input loop, rather than pushing your whole screen upwards. It's like getting a new bookshelf that comes with a powerful cataloging system to pinpoint any book, neatly tucks annoying notification slips into the pages, and smooths out the awkward gaps between the books.

items.original:
Added a `/codesearch` command (aliases `/cs` and `/search`) to interactively search code across your workspace, interpreting queries as regex by default with `-F`/`--literal` for exact matching and `f:`/`file:` globs to include or exclude paths.
Added an indicator at each context-compaction boundary so you can see where earlier compaction happened.
Improved eligibility error handling by showing errors with a verification URL inline in the input loop instead of stacking them above the screen.
Removed the padding spaces around inline code for tighter rendering.
Fixed code-block corruption where `$..$` math expansion desynced from the Markdown parser and mangled fenced shell snippets such as `git fetch "$GIT_REMOTE"` by detecting fenced code blocks line-by-line.

title.zh-TW: 啟動與載入效能大躍進，不再繞遠路讀檔案
title.en: Startup and discovery speeds skyrocket, cutting out redundant file reads

body.zh-TW: 現在你打開 Antigravity（Google 的終端機 AI 助手）時，不用再枯等它暖機了。以前在啟動階段，系統會為了尋找技能（skills，提供額外能力的設定）而卡死在漫長的檔案掃描上；現在它改成非同步載入（asynchronously loading，讓主程式先跑，背景慢慢找），大幅縮短了啟動時間。不只如此，當系統在找技能、規則（rules）、代理或掛鉤（hooks）這類客製化設定時，現在懂得把所有路線整合起來並快取（caching，把查過的結果暫存起來直接用）尋找紀錄，砍掉了多餘的磁碟讀寫。同時，它也修好了一個小蟲：如果你的規則資料夾是用符號連結（symlink，指向另一個位置的檔案）連過去的，系統不會再笨笨地把它載入兩次。就像你開車出門，以前每次都要全車地毯式安檢，現在只要一發動就能上路，而且導航系統會記住去過的地方，不用每次都在同一個路口找路。
body.en: You no longer have to stare at a stalling screen while Antigravity (Google's terminal AI assistant) warms up. Previously, during bring-up, the CLI would completely block your interactive startup while it laboriously scanned your file system to discover skills (settings providing extra capabilities); it now loads them asynchronously (letting the main interface start instantly while loading happens in the background), drastically cutting down startup latency. Moreover, when the system hunts for customizations like skills, rules, agents, or hooks, it now consolidates these directory walks and caches (temporarily saving results for instant reuse) its filesystem lookups, eliminating redundant I/O reads. It also fixed a minor hiccup where customization rules were loaded twice if the directory was reached via a symlink (a file pointing to another location). It's like driving your car: instead of a full-body security sweep every time you turn the key, you can just start the engine and go, and your GPS remembers the routes so it doesn't have to recalculate at every intersection.

items.original:
Improved interactive startup latency by loading skills asynchronously so the CLI no longer blocks on a synchronous, filesystem-heavy skill-discovery pass during bring-up.
Improved customization loading latency for skills, rules, agents, and hooks by consolidating directory walks and caching filesystem lookups to cut redundant I/O during discovery.
Fixed customization rules being loaded twice when a rules directory is reachable through a symlink.

title.zh-TW: 畫面不再耗能死當，長對話與滑鼠複製更順手
title.en: No more CPU spikes on huge chats, and mouse copying works smoothly

body.zh-TW: 在使用不閃爍模式（no-flickering mode，讓終端機畫面更新時不會一直閃爍的顯示模式）時，你的電腦不會再因為超長對話而卡死了。以前對話累積太多，每次更新畫面都會重新把對話索引（index）越長越大，導致 CPU 狂飆；現在重建索引改成了冪等（idempotent，不管跑幾次結果都一樣，不會無限疊加），讓負載穩定下來。此模式下的行數計算也修好了，狀態列不再跑出視窗外；關閉獨立文件預覽（artifact，系統生成的獨立文件預覽）詳細畫面後，也不會再有幽靈留言殘留在螢幕上。現在更支援了選取即複製（copy-on-select）：滑鼠拖曳反白，放開就能把純文字（不含 ANSI 顏色代碼）複製到剪貼簿，且虛擬卷軸會自動隱藏不礙事。就像畫超長的清明上河圖，以前每畫一筆書僮都要從頭數到尾，現在他只看最新變化；當你想臨摹其中一段，一框起來就印好給你，畫軸也會自動閃避。
body.en: Your computer will no longer choke on massive conversations when using no-flickering mode (a display mode that prevents the terminal screen from flashing on every update). Previously, as the chat grew, every single screen refresh would rebuild the conversation index (the internal map of the chat) larger and larger, causing high CPU usage and unbounded rendering costs. This index rebuild is now idempotent (meaning it converges to a stable state no matter how many times it runs), keeping system load stable. Row math in this mode was also corrected so the status line stays neatly inside your viewport, and dismissing an artifact (a standalone document preview generated by the system) detail view will no longer leave ghost comments on the screen. Even better, it now supports copy-on-select: dragging to highlight text and simply releasing the mouse instantly copies the clean text (stripped of ANSI terminal color codes) to your clipboard, hiding the virtual scrollbar so it doesn't interfere. It's like working on a mile-long scroll — previously, your assistant would recount the entire scroll every time you added a stroke; now, they only process what's needed. And when you want to trace a section, circling it instantly gives you a clean photocopy, while the scroll handles tuck themselves away.

items.original:
Added copy-on-select in no-flickering mode so dragging highlights text and releasing the mouse copies the ANSI-stripped selection to the clipboard, and hides the virtual scrollbar so it no longer interferes with copying multi-line output.
Fixed high CPU and unbounded render cost on large conversations in no-flickering mode by making index rebuilds idempotent so the conversation index converges instead of growing on every rebuild.
Fixed lingering artifact comments after dismissing the artifact detail view and corrected no-flickering-mode row math so the status line renders correctly within the viewport.

title.zh-TW: 權限放行不再出包，無頭模式與 Linux 登入更安分
title.en: Tighter permissions for headless runs, and no more login loops on Linux

body.zh-TW: 當你把系統放在背景自動跑任務時，它不會再自作主張開後門。以前在無頭模式（headless runs，無終端機視窗的執行模式）下，遇到需確認權限的工具時不是卡死就是自動同意；現在會溫和拒絕並提示需設定哪條白名單（allow-rule）。在「一律同意（always-proceed）」模式下，也不會再錯誤批准寫入工作區之外的檔案。Linux 使用者以前常因作業系統鑰匙圈（OS keyring，存密碼的保險箱）讀取太慢而被切斷，逼得重新登入；現在若無 D-Bus 工作階段匯流排（D-Bus session bus，用來在工作階段溝通的管道）就直接繞過鑰匙圈，超時先跳過一小時並放寬讀取時間。就像派機器人去倉庫，遇到鎖住的門它不硬闖也不傻等，只回報缺哪把鑰匙；保全動作慢，它也願意多等，不會動不動要你重簽通行證。
body.en: When running tasks in the background, the system no longer makes unauthorized decisions. Previously in headless runs (modes without a terminal window, like `-p`), tools requiring permission either hung or auto-approved; the CLI now soft-denies them and prints a stderr notice showing the allow-rule needed to permit them. In "always-proceed" mode, outside-of-workspace file writes are no longer incorrectly auto-approved. Linux users are saved from login loops caused by slow OS keyring reads; the CLI now bypasses the keyring if no D-Bus session bus is present, skips it for an hour after a timeout, and extends timeout windows. Like sending a robot to a warehouse: encountering a locked door, it reports the key it needs; if the guard is slow, it waits longer instead of triggering alarms.

items.original:
Fixed headless (`-p`) runs hanging or silently auto-approving tools that require a permission confirmation, so the CLI now soft-denies such tools and prints a stderr notice naming the allow-rule needed to permit them.
Fixed outside-of-workspace file writes being incorrectly auto-approved in always-proceed mode.
Fixed repeated sign-in prompts on Linux caused by the OS keyring: the CLI now bypasses the keyring when no D-Bus session bus is present (headless hosts and containers), skips it for an hour after a timeout, and uses longer keyring timeouts so a slow-but-successful credential read is no longer cut short and forced into a fresh login.

title.zh-TW: 外部工具連線設下停損，對話不再突然壞死
title.en: Timeout limits on runaway servers save conversations from sudden death

body.zh-TW: 當你讓 AI 呼叫外部工具時，它不會再因為對方的失誤而跟著同歸於盡了。以前如果你的 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連結外部工具的通訊協定）伺服器沒有回應，代理（agent）就會像石化了一樣無限期死等；現在系統為連線、列出工具清單與呼叫工具的動作都設下了超時停損點（timeouts），時間一到就會果斷放棄。此外，有些特定的工具呼叫以前會弄壞對話紀錄（corrupted history），導致 AI 之後完全無法回應，整個對話直接壞死；這個嚴重的蟲現在也被抓出來修好了。就像派助理去拿資料，以前沒人他會永遠死等並弄丟聯絡簿；現在給他設了超時規定，時間一到就直接回報，也不會再搞丟聯絡簿。
body.en: When you ask the AI to invoke an external tool, it will no longer get dragged down by unresponsive servers. Previously, if your MCP (Model Context Protocol, a standard connecting AI to external tools) server simply never responded, the agent would freeze like a statue and hang indefinitely; the system now actively bounds connection attempts, tool-listing requests, and per-tool-call attempts with strict timeouts, allowing it to gracefully give up and move on. Furthermore, certain tool calls used to catastrophically break the conversation by corrupting the history (the underlying memory of the chat), which blocked all further responses and killed the session instantly; this fatal bug has been fully squashed. It's like sending an assistant to fetch a document — they used to stand there forever if the room was empty and lose their walkie-talkie; now you've given them a strict timeout rule, so they come back if nobody answers, and keep their radio perfectly safe.

items.original:
Fixed MCP servers hanging the agent indefinitely when a server never responds by bounding connection, tool-listing, and per-tool-call attempts with timeouts.
Fixed conversations breaking after certain tool calls, which previously corrupted the conversation history and blocked all further responses.

entries: Added an `f` (full diff) shortcut to the create-file tool review screen so new-file confirmations can open a full-screen diff view, matching the existing file-edit experience.

Added support for pasting the OAuth authorization code in print mode (-p) via the controlling terminal (/dev/tty on POSIX and CONIN$ on Windows) when stdin is consumed by a piped prompt, and made truly headless runs fail fast with an actionable message instead of blocking.

Improved responsiveness on large conversations (5000+ steps) in no flickering mode by switching hot-path line-count methods to pointer receivers, cutting the per-frame prefix-sum cost and eliminating sustained 99% CPU and keystroke lag.

Fixed print mode silently downgrading to the default model when --model cannot be resolved by hard-failing with a non-zero exit and listing the available models, while interactive sessions keep the fallback-with-warning behavior.

Fixed permission checks not respecting the allowlist for nested command substitutions, so a command like echo "$(dirname $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel))" now runs without prompting when echo and git are allowlisted, instead of double-counting the nested command and prompting for review.
Fixed the CLI keybindings file staying out of sync with /keybindings when new default bindings are introduced by persisting the injected defaults while preserving user overrides.
Fixed garbled builtin tool headers such as CodeSearch(4 files found...) by mapping generic tool steps back to clean summaries like Read(/path) and CodeSearch(query).

Fixed mcp manager failing to resolve tool schema paths in standalone mode and leaking MCP server subprocesses after shutdown, which previously caused panics and cleanup failures for custom agents loading MCP tools.
Fixed a data race and copy-on-write violation when updating subagent states by cloning their stats before in-place mutation, preventing corrupted step counts and status for parallel subagents.

title.zh-TW: 終端機不再卡頓，介面顯示與預覽更完善
title.en: Terminal becomes smoother, tool headers are clearer, and new files get full diffs

body.zh-TW: 當你長對話執行到 5000 步（step，AI 動作次數）以上時，終端機不再卡頓或吃滿 CPU。以前在不閃爍模式（no flickering mode，防止畫面更新閃爍的機制）下，長對話會因行數計算消耗大量資源而打字卡頓；現在優化計算後已徹底解決。另外，新建檔案確認時可按 f 開啟全螢幕的差異預覽（full diff，完整的更動對照），體驗與修改現有檔案一致。最後，對話裡的工具標題不再顯示 CodeSearch(4 files found...) 等混亂內容，改為 Read(/path) 般乾淨的摘要。就像看超長小說，以前越後面越難翻且目錄凌亂，現在每一頁都很順手、目錄整齊，還能隨時拉出全螢幕對照。
body.en: Your terminal stays responsive and typing stays buttery smooth even if your conversation goes over 5,000 steps (step, AI action counts). Previously, in no flickering mode, counting lines for long chats caused high CPU and lag on every frame; this logic has been optimized to resolve the bottleneck. Also, when confirming new file creation, you can now press f to open a full screen difference preview (full diff) to see complete changes, matching the experience of editing existing files. Finally, chat tool headers are cleaned up from messy strings like CodeSearch(4 files found...) to neat summaries like Read(/path). It's like reading a massive novel where pages used to get harder to turn, the index is clear, and you can pull out a full-screen comparison/diff view anytime.

items.original:
Added an `f` (full diff) shortcut to the create-file tool review screen so new-file confirmations can open a full-screen diff view, matching the existing file-edit experience.
Improved responsiveness on large conversations (5000+ steps) in no flickering mode by switching hot-path line-count methods to pointer receivers, cutting the per-frame prefix-sum cost and eliminating sustained 99% CPU and keystroke lag.
Fixed garbled builtin tool headers such as CodeSearch(4 files found...) by mapping generic tool steps back to clean summaries like Read(/path) and CodeSearch(query).

title.zh-TW: 腳本模式更可靠，模型不偷換、授權不卡死
title.en: Print mode fails honestly on missing models and handles auth gracefully

body.zh-TW: 當你用腳本自動執行任務時，系統不再默默更換模型或卡死。在列印模式（print mode，印出答案即結束的執行方式）下，若指定的模型不存在，系統會立刻報錯中斷並列出可用清單，不再默默降級（但互動模式仍維持警告並使用備援模型（fallback，指主要方案失效時的替代方案）的舊規）。此外，用管線餵指令給腳本時，若需要登入，你可以直接在控制終端機（controlling terminal，如 /dev/tty）貼上 OAuth 授權碼；若在無頭模式（headless runs，沒有終端機視窗的執行模式）下則會立刻報錯，不再傻傻等待。就像派助理買限量便當，買不到時他會立刻打電話告知並回報菜單讓你重挑，需要刷卡時也會把刷卡機遞到你面前；若你不在場，他會直接回報失敗，而不是在櫃檯乾等。
body.en: When automating tasks with scripts, the system stops silently changing models or hanging. In print mode (-p, exit-after-printing), if a specified model is missing, the CLI fails fast and lists available options (interactive sessions keep the old fallback-with-warning behavior). Additionally, if piping prompts consumes stdin and login is required, you can paste the OAuth authorization code directly into the controlling terminal (/dev/tty). Truly headless runs fail fast instead of blocking. Like sending an assistant to buy a lunch box — they call you immediately with the menu if it is sold out, and hand you the card reader if payment is needed; if you aren't there, they return instead of waiting forever.

items.original:
Added support for pasting the OAuth authorization code in print mode (-p) via the controlling terminal (/dev/tty on POSIX and CONIN$ on Windows) when stdin is consumed by a piped prompt, and made truly headless runs fail fast with an actionable message instead of blocking.
Fixed print mode silently downgrading to the default model when --model cannot be resolved by hard-failing with a non-zero exit and listing the available models, while interactive sessions keep the fallback-with-warning behavior.

title.zh-TW: 捷徑自動更新不覆蓋，指令檢查不再大驚小怪
title.en: Keybindings stay updated automatically, and nested commands respect allowlists

body.zh-TW: 自訂快捷鍵能隨著系統升級自動更新，指令安全檢查也更聰明了。當系統加入新的預設快捷鍵時，它會自動補上新值，同時完整保留你修改過的按鍵配置（user overrides）。另外，當你輸入包著另一層指令的巢狀指令替換（nested command substitutions，如在 echo 裡包著 git 查詢）時，只要這兩個指令都在允許清單（allowlist，白名單）裡，系統就會直接放行，不再重複計算層數（double-counting）而跳出提示詢問。就像遊戲更新後會自動加上新技能按鍵，且不影響你改過的自訂鍵；也像機場安檢看到包包裡裝著已過安檢的隨身包，不會再叫你拆開檢查一次。
body.en: Custom shortcuts now upgrade automatically, and command security checks are smarter. When the system adds new default keybindings, it injects them while preserving your custom configurations (user overrides). Also, when you write nested command substitutions (like echo wrapping a git query), the system runs them without interruption as long as both commands are on your allowlist. It no longer double-counts the nested layers to prompt for permission. Like updating a game — new ultimate keybindings are added without wiping out your custom jump button; and airport security seeing a pre-screened bag inside another pre-screened bag no longer forces you to unpack it again.

items.original:
Fixed permission checks not respecting the allowlist for nested command substitutions, so a command like echo "$(dirname $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel))" now runs without prompting when echo and git are allowlisted, instead of double-counting the nested command and prompting for review.
Fixed the CLI keybindings file staying out of sync with /keybindings when new default bindings are introduced by persisting the injected defaults while preserving user overrides.

title.zh-TW: 代理分身狀態更精準，MCP 工具不留殘局
title.en: Subagents report accurate states, and MCP tools stop leaking memory

body.zh-TW: 當你叫出多個代理幫忙或掛載外部工具時，進度追蹤更精準，系統也更乾淨。多個代理分身（subagents，平行處理任務的 AI 助手）同時工作時，以前會因資料競爭（data race，搶改同一筆資料）和違反寫入時複製（copy-on-write violation）導致狀態錯亂；現在修改狀態前會先複製紀錄，不再互踩。此外，載入 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）工具時，以前在獨立模式下會找不到路徑且殘留背景程序（subprocesses）；現在能正確定位並在關閉時清乾淨。就像請裝潢工班，以前搶簽同一張表導致塗改混亂，現在每人發一張表；離開時也一定帶走所有工具，不留電線垃圾。
body.en: Task progress is fully accurate and the system cleans up properly when you run agent teams or load external tools. When multiple subagents (AI helpers running in parallel) work together, the system used to suffer from a data race and copy-on-write violation, corrupting step counts; they now clone records before updating to avoid collisions. Furthermore, when loading MCP (Model Context Protocol) tools, the manager previously failed to resolve paths in standalone mode and leaked background subprocesses; it now locates paths perfectly and sweeps up processes on exit. Like hiring a crew — they used to fight over one sign-in sheet but now get individual clipboards, and clean up all their tools on departure.

items.original:
Fixed mcp manager failing to resolve tool schema paths in standalone mode and leaking MCP server subprocesses after shutdown, which previously caused panics and cleanup failures for custom agents loading MCP tools.
Fixed a data race and copy-on-write violation when updating subagent states by cloning their stats before in-place mutation, preventing corrupted step counts and status for parallel subagents.

entries: Added the `--agent` flag and `agent/agents` subcommand, allowing users to select a custom agent at launch and list available agents.

Added in-file keyword search (`/`) and jump navigation (`n/N`) to the artifact detail viewer, allowing users to find and cycle through matches without disrupting terminal escape sequences or image grids.
Fixed print mode (`--print` / `-p`) silently exiting with a success code and empty output when a request failed server-side, now writing the error to stderr and returning a non-zero exit code.
Fixed `agy -p` hanging when run inside a shell script or subprocess by no longer reading stdin when a prompt is provided via a flag.
Fixed a data race on the `/btw` cancellation function.

Added support for displaying nested subagents (grandchild and deeper) and handling tool confirmation requests across all subagent depths by recursively relaying nested subtrajectory updates to the root conversation.
Changed the default mode to respect write_file permissions allowlisted in `settings.json` under `permission.allow`, so pre-approved file writes no longer prompt for review.
Changed the default name for the newly initialized project to `CLI Project` for clearer workspace identification.
Improved the session exit output by placing the resume command on its own line, making it easier to copy and paste in terminals and tools like tmux.

Fixed interactive `/diff` viewer defects in Jujutsu (jj) workspaces by correctly prioritizing `.jj` over `.git` in colocated repos, fixing commit hash regex boundaries, and correctly highlighting active `@` graph nodes.
Fixed workspace-local hooks defined in `<workspace>/.agents/hooks.json` not loading after trusting a folder by reloading hooks whenever workspaces change.
Fixed misaligned markdown tables containing file links in chat output.

title.zh-TW: 預設改成「寫檔前先給你過目」：逐行看差異、想留哪段自己挑
title.en: New default: Antigravity pauses before writing files and shows a line-level diff

body.zh-TW: Antigravity 動你的檔案之前，現在預設會先停下來給你過目。新的 request-review 模式（顧名思義「請求審核」——動你的檔案前先請你過目）在每次寫檔前攤開逐行差異預覽（diff preview，把改前改後逐行並排、標紅標綠的對照畫面，按 f 開啟），你可以整批接受，也可以一段留一段丟；連新建檔案都有專屬的「Create file」預覽，讓你先看內容再點頭。就像裁縫改衣服前先讓你試穿別上珠針的版本，滿意哪段留哪段，而不是改完才給你看成品。
body.en: Before Antigravity touches your files, it now pauses by default and shows its work. The new request-review mode spreads out a line-level diff preview before every write (a view marking removals red and additions green line by line, opened with f), letting you accept the whole batch or keep some chunks and toss others; even brand-new files get their own "Create file" preview so you approve the content first. Like a tailor pinning the alterations and letting you try them on before sewing, instead of showing you the finished jacket.

items.original: Added `request-review` (default) mode as the default execution behavior: automatically pauses before file write operations to display an interactive, line-level diff preview (`f` shortcut) where users can review, accept, or reject individual code modifications before they are saved to disk. Added a dedicated "Create file" confirmation preview for new file creations (`write_to_file` without overwrite): renders new content as an addition-only diff preview. (1.1.0)

title.zh-TW: shift+tab 循環三種執行模式，/plan 取代 /planning
title.en: Cycle execution modes with shift+tab; /plan replaces /planning

body.zh-TW: 執行模式切換正式開放：按 shift+tab 就能在 default（每次寫檔先問）、accept-edits（放行編輯）、plan（只規劃不動手）三檔之間循環。指令也整併了——/plan 取代舊的 /planning、/fast 直接移除，切換方式收斂成一套，不再多頭馬車。就像檯燈從三顆分開的開關變成一顆旋鈕，轉一下換一檔。
body.en: Execution-mode switching is now public: shift+tab cycles through default (ask before each write), accept-edits (edits sail through), and plan (plan only, hands off). Commands got consolidated too — /plan replaces the old /planning and /fast is removed, folding mode switching into one coherent set. Like a lamp trading three scattered switches for a single knob you click through.

items.original: Agent execution mode cycling is now publicly available: `default` -> `accept-edits` -> `plan`. Added `/plan` mode to replace legacy `/planning`, and removed `/fast` slash commands: consolidated and simplified execution mode switching around `shift+tab` mode cycling and the `/plan` mode prefix. (1.1.0)

title.zh-TW: 預設模式進 /settings 面板，改完立刻生效
title.en: Set your default execution mode right in /settings

body.zh-TW: 想固定用某個執行模式，現在到 /settings 面板挑 Agent Mode 就好，改完即時生效，不用再手動編輯 settings.json（設定檔）、也不用每次啟動都掛 --mode 參數。就像冷氣終於有了遙控器上的「預設模式」鈕，不必每次開機都爬去主機上按。
body.en: To make one execution mode your default, just pick Agent Mode in the /settings panel — it takes effect immediately, with no more hand-editing settings.json (the config file) and no more passing --mode at every launch. Like an air conditioner finally getting a "default mode" button on the remote, so you stop climbing up to the unit each time.

items.original: Added an `Agent Mode` option to the `/settings` panel so users can set and persist a default execution mode (`default`, `accept-edits`, `plan`) without manually editing `settings.json` or passing `--mode` on startup, with real-time synchronization so changes take effect immediately. (1.1.0)

title.zh-TW: 啟動就能指定要用哪個自訂代理
title.en: Pick a custom agent right at launch with --agent

body.zh-TW: 啟動時就能指定要用哪個自訂代理（custom agent，你事先寫好個性與專長的分身）：掛上 --agent 旗標直接點名，agent／agents 子指令還能列出手上有哪些分身可挑。以前得先進門再換人，現在像叫車 App 直接指定司機，上車前就選好。
body.en: You can now pick a custom agent (a persona you've pre-written with its own skills and style) right at launch: name it with the --agent flag, and the agent/agents subcommands list which personas you have. You used to have to walk in first and swap afterwards; now it's like a ride-hailing app that lets you choose the driver before getting in.

items.original: Added the `--agent` flag and `agent/agents` subcommand, allowing users to select a custom agent at launch and list available agents. (1.1.1)

title.zh-TW: 成果檢視器能按 / 搜尋、n/N 跳轉了
title.en: Search inside artifacts with / and hop between matches with n/N

body.zh-TW: 在成果檢視器（artifact viewer，看代理產出的檔案或報告的畫面）裡按 / 就能就地搜尋關鍵字，n 跳下一個、N 跳上一個，長報告不用再用眼睛慢慢掃。就像看紙本說明書終於改成看 PDF，Ctrl+F 一按直達你要的那行。
body.en: In the artifact viewer (the screen for reading files and reports an agent produced), press / to search for a keyword in place, then n and N to hop between matches — no more eyeball-scanning long reports. Like trading a paper manual for a PDF where one Ctrl+F jumps straight to the line you need.

items.original: Added in-file keyword search (`/`) and jump navigation (`n/N`) to the artifact detail viewer, allowing users to find and cycle through matches without disrupting terminal escape sequences or image grids. (1.1.1)

title.zh-TW: 腳本派工救星：-p 失敗會老實報錯，也不再卡住不動
title.en: Script users rejoice: -p now reports failures honestly and never hangs

body.zh-TW: 用腳本呼叫 agy 的人這條最有感：print 模式（--print／-p，不開介面、印完答案就走的無頭用法）以前伺服器端失敗時會裝沒事——回傳成功代碼、輸出空白，害你的腳本以為任務完成了；現在錯誤會寫進 stderr（標準錯誤輸出，專門裝錯誤訊息的通道）並回傳非零代碼。另外在 shell 腳本或子程序裡跑 agy -p 會卡住等輸入的毛病也修了。就像外送員以前送失敗會默默把空袋子掛你門口，現在會確實打電話告訴你「餐沒送到」。
body.en: If you call agy from scripts, this is your fix: print mode (--print / -p, the headless usage that prints an answer and exits) used to play innocent when a request failed server-side — exiting with a success code and empty output, so your script believed the job was done; failures now go to stderr (the standard error stream, the channel reserved for error messages) with a non-zero exit code. The bug where agy -p hung waiting for input inside shell scripts and subprocesses is fixed too. Like a delivery courier who used to silently hang an empty bag on your door after a failed run — now they actually call to say the food didn't make it.

items.original: Fixed print mode (`--print` / `-p`) silently exiting with a success code and empty output when a request failed server-side, now writing the error to stderr and returning a non-zero exit code. Fixed `agy -p` hanging when run inside a shell script or subprocess by no longer reading stdin when a prompt is provided via a flag. (1.1.1)

title.zh-TW: 放行過的寫檔不再重複問
title.en: Pre-approved file writes skip the review prompt

body.zh-TW: 你在 settings.json 的 permission.allow 允許清單（事先放行的白名單）裡核准過的寫檔動作，預設模式現在會直接放行，不再每次都跳審查。就像機場的常客快速通關——身家早就查核過的人，不必每趟都重新排安檢。
body.en: File writes you've already allowlisted under permission.allow in settings.json (the pre-approved whitelist) now sail through in default mode instead of prompting for review every time. Like an airport trusted-traveler lane — once you've been vetted, you don't re-queue for screening on every trip.

items.original: Changed the default mode to respect write_file permissions allowlisted in `settings.json` under `permission.allow`, so pre-approved file writes no longer prompt for review. (1.1.1)

title.zh-TW: 介面細節總打磨：差異預覽、快捷鍵提示、表格對齊都變順眼
title.en: A round of UI polish: diff previews, keybinding hints, and table alignment

body.zh-TW: 這輪順手把一圈介面細節磨亮了：檔案編輯的差異預覽補上前後文和分段線更好讀；各面板頁尾的快捷鍵提示會尊重你自訂的鍵位、不再寫死；/resume 選單裡重新命名對話的輸入框不再把長標題吃掉；聊天輸出裡帶檔案連結的 Markdown 表格也不再歪掉。像車子進廠保養——沒換引擎，但每個按鈕都變順手了。
body.en: A lap of interface polish landed this round: file-edit diff previews gain context lines and section separators for easier reading; footer keybinding hints across panels now respect your customized keys instead of showing hardcoded ones; the rename box in the /resume picker stops swallowing long titles; and Markdown tables with file links in chat output stop skewing. Like a car service visit — same engine, but every knob feels smoother.

items.original: Improved file-edit diff preview rendering: computed accurate line-level diffs with context lines (3 lines) and hunk separators. Improved UI footer keybinding hints across all panels by replacing hardcoded hint strings with centralized layout helpers that dynamically respect customized keybinding configurations. Improved the multiline conversation rename view in the `/resume` picker. Fixed misaligned markdown tables containing file links in chat output. (1.1.0–1.1.1)

entries: Agent execution mode cycling is now publicly available: `default` -> `accept-edits` -> `plan`)

Added `request-review` (default) mode as the default execution behavior: automatically pauses before file write operations to display an interactive, line-level diff preview (`f` shortcut) where users can review, accept, or reject individual code modifications before they are saved to disk.

Added an `Agent Mode` option to the `/settings` panel so users can set and persist a default execution mode (`default`, `accept-edits`, `plan`) without manually editing `settings.json` or passing `--mode` on startup, with real-time synchronization so changes take effect immediately.
Added a dedicated `"Create file"` confirmation preview for new file creations (`write_to_file` without overwrite): renders new content as an addition-only diff preview.
Added `/plan` mode to replace legacy `/planning`, and removed `/fast` slash commands: consolidated and simplified execution mode switching around `shift+tab` mode cycling and the `/plan` mode prefix

Improved file-edit diff preview rendering: computed accurate line-level diffs with context lines (`3` lines) and hunk separators, capped inline preview height with truncation hints, and added a comment confirmation prompt when exiting the diff view with unsent comments.

Improved UI footer keybinding hints across all panels (such as `/tasks`, `/agents`, `/permissions`, and `/mcp`) by replacing hardcoded hint strings with centralized layout helpers that dynamically respect customized global and local keybinding configurations (`keybindings.json`).

Improved the multiline conversation rename view in the `/resume` picker by dynamically adjusting input box width and padding, and right-aligning metadata columns (`workspace`, `steps`, `time`) on the top line to prevent horizontal scrolling or layout shifts during active renaming.

Fixed the tool confirmation dialog to accurately check normalized file URIs against active workspace directories, resolving an issue where valid in-workspace file creations and reads were incorrectly flagged with an `"Reason: outside workspace"` warning.

Fixed workspace initialization failures when launching the CLI inside dot-prefixed directories (such as  .parent_dir/project ) by scoping path exclusion filters strictly to relative paths inside the workspace rather than rejecting dot-prefixed ancestor directories.
Fixed the `/agents` view header displaying `agent.json` instead of `agent.md` when creating new subagents.

Fixed the `/agents` panel's `"Create New Agents"` section displaying the wrong global configuration directory (`~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/` instead of `~/.gemini/config/`), ensuring users create global subagents in the location actively scanned during startup discovery.

Fixed statusline shortcut hints (`? for shortcuts`) and redundant escape hints (`Esc to cancel`) erroneously appearing inside full-screen overlay panels (such as `/changelog`, `/artifact`, and `/settings`) by correctly tracking overlay panel states.
Fixed inconsistent timestamp formatting in the `/tasks` panel and task detail views by converting agent-initiated background task timestamps (`time.Time`) from UTC to the local timezone.

title.zh-TW: 預設改檔前先讓你看差異，還能直接用面板切換代理模式
title.en: Previews diffs before editing files by default, and lets you cycle agent modes directly from the panel

body.zh-TW: 改檔前你會先看到差異，可決定是否接受。，會預設先暫停並清楚秀出修改前後的差異。以前程式可能不作聲就把檔案改了，現在它會跳出精細到每一行的差異預覽（diff preview），讓你能先檢查並決定要不要接受；如果是建立新檔案，也會有專屬的預覽畫面，而且如果你在看差異時留了註解還沒送出就想關掉，系統也會貼心提醒你。你也不用再為了切換這些執行模式（像是不問就直接改的 accept-edits 或只規劃的 plan）而去改設定檔或加啟動參數，現在按 shift+tab 就能直接輪替切換，或到 /settings 面板裡用「代理模式」選項點一下就立刻生效。舊版的 /planning 與 /fast 快捷指令也一併整併成更簡潔的 /plan。就像去剪頭髮，以前理髮師可能聽完就直接動刀，現在他預設會先拿鏡子比劃給你看要剪哪裡，你點頭了他才剪，而且你想換成「不廢話直接剪」模式，只要在座位旁的面板點一下就行。
body.en: Before writing or modifying files, the system now defaults to pausing and clearly showing the differences. Previously, the program might silently change files; now, it pops up an interactive line-level diff preview so you can review and decide whether to accept the edits. New file creations also get their own dedicated preview, and if you try to close the diff view with unsent comments, the system will politely warn you. You also no longer need to edit config files or pass startup arguments to switch execution modes (like accept-edits for direct writing or plan for just planning) — you can now cycle through them directly by pressing shift+tab, or instantly apply them via the Agent Mode option in the /settings panel. The old /planning and /fast slash commands have also been consolidated into a cleaner /plan. Like getting a haircut: the barber used to just start snipping right after you spoke, but now they default to holding up a mirror and pointing out exactly what they're going to cut before you nod, and if you want to switch to a "just cut it" mode, you just tap a button next to your chair.

items.original:
Agent execution mode cycling is now publicly available: `default` -> `accept-edits` -> `plan`)
Added `request-review` (default) mode as the default execution behavior: automatically pauses before file write operations to display an interactive, line-level diff preview (`f` shortcut) where users can review, accept, or reject individual code modifications before they are saved to disk.
Added an `Agent Mode` option to the `/settings` panel so users can set and persist a default execution mode (`default`, `accept-edits`, `plan`) without manually editing `settings.json` or passing `--mode` on startup, with real-time synchronization so changes take effect immediately.
Added a dedicated `"Create file"` confirmation preview for new file creations (`write_to_file` without overwrite): renders new content as an addition-only diff preview.
Added `/plan` mode to replace legacy `/planning`, and removed `/fast` slash commands: consolidated and simplified execution mode switching around `shift+tab` mode cycling and the `/plan` mode prefix
Improved file-edit diff preview rendering: computed accurate line-level diffs with context lines (`3` lines) and hunk separators, capped inline preview height with truncation hints, and added a comment confirmation prompt when exiting the diff view with unsent comments.

title.zh-TW: 介面排版更聰明，快捷鍵提示與時間顯示不再錯亂
title.en: Smarter UI layouts, with accurate keybinding hints and correctly localized timestamps

body.zh-TW: 你在各個面板看任務或改名時，畫面變得更整齊，提示也不會再牛頭不對馬嘴了。以前底部的快捷鍵提示是寫死的，就算你自己改了快捷鍵設定檔（keybindings.json），畫面上還是教你舊的按法；現在它會乖乖照你改的顯示。在 /resume 裡幫對話改名時，輸入框會自動調整寬度，旁邊的資訊也會好好靠右對齊，不會因為你打字就讓整個畫面亂跳。全螢幕面板（像設定或更新日誌）裡也不會再跑出多餘的「按 ? 看快捷鍵」或「按 Esc 取消」來干擾視線。另外，背景任務的時間戳（timestamp）也不會再傻傻顯示格林威治標準時間（UTC），現在都會自動換算成你所在地的時間。就像看展覽，以前每個展區門口的導覽圖都是舊版的，有些地方還貼著不相干的「往上走」箭頭，現在所有告示牌都跟你手上的最新地圖同步，而且營業時間也終於換成你熟悉的本地時間了。
body.en: The interface layout is now much tidier when you view tasks or rename conversations, and the hints no longer confidently give you the wrong instructions. Previously, the keybinding hints at the bottom of the screen were hardcoded; even if you modified your custom keybindings file (keybindings.json), the screen would still display the default keys. Now, it accurately reflects your custom bindings. When renaming a conversation in the /resume picker, the input box dynamically adjusts its width, and metadata columns properly align to the right, preventing the screen from jumping around while you type. Full-screen panels (like settings or changelogs) will also stop flashing redundant "Press ? for shortcuts" or "Esc to cancel" messages that clutter the view. Moreover, background task timestamps no longer blindly display UTC; they now correctly convert to your local timezone. Like walking through a museum: the old entrance maps used to be outdated and plastered with irrelevant "Walk Up" arrows, but now every signpost perfectly syncs with the latest map in your hand, and the operating hours are finally shown in your local time.

items.original:
Improved UI footer keybinding hints across all panels (such as `/tasks`, `/agents`, `/permissions`, and `/mcp`) by replacing hardcoded hint strings with centralized layout helpers that dynamically respect customized global and local keybinding configurations (`keybindings.json`).
Improved the multiline conversation rename view in the `/resume` picker by dynamically adjusting input box width and padding, and right-aligning metadata columns (`workspace`, `steps`, `time`) on the top line to prevent horizontal scrolling or layout shifts during active renaming.
Fixed statusline shortcut hints (`? for shortcuts`) and redundant escape hints (`Esc to cancel`) erroneously appearing inside full-screen overlay panels (such as `/changelog`, `/artifact`, and `/settings`) by correctly tracking overlay panel states.
Fixed inconsistent timestamp formatting in the `/tasks` panel and task detail views by converting agent-initiated background task timestamps (`time.Time`) from UTC to the local timezone.

title.zh-TW: 修好各種路徑與目錄誤判，建新檔案不再被無辜阻擋
title.en: Fixes path and directory misjudgments, stopping innocent file creations from being blocked

body.zh-TW: 你在自己的工作目錄裡建立或讀取檔案，不會再莫名其妙被系統警告了。以前因為路徑判斷的瑕疵，就算你明明在正確的資料夾裡做事，工具確認對話框還是會誤判並跳出「超出工作目錄外」的警告；現在這個問題修好了。如果你把專案放在名稱有加點的前置目錄（像是 .parent_dir/project），以前系統會因為過濾規則太廣而啟動失敗，現在也懂得只管目錄裡面的事而不會亂擋。建立新代理時，面板上的路徑終於指向正確的設定檔總目錄（~/.gemini/config/），標題也不會再把應該是 agent.md 的附檔名錯寫成 agent.json。就像進自己公司辦公室，以前警衛會因為你走過的路名叫「.暗巷」就不准你上班，或者明明在自己座位上辦公卻被警告「擅闖禁區」，現在警衛終於認得你而且認得公司的範圍了。
body.en: Creating or reading files inside your own workspace will no longer inexplicably trigger system warnings. Previously, due to a flaw in path resolution, the tool confirmation dialog would misjudge perfectly valid in-workspace actions and throw an "outside workspace" warning; this is now fixed. If you kept your project inside a parent directory that started with a dot (like .parent_dir/project), the system used to fail to start because its exclusion filters were overly broad; it now correctly limits its checks to paths within the workspace. When creating a new agent, the panel now points to the correct global config directory (~/.gemini/config/), and the header no longer mistakenly lists the extension as agent.json when it should be agent.md. Like entering your own office building: the security guard used to ban you from working just because the road you took was named ".dark_alley", or warned you for "trespassing" while you were sitting at your own desk; now the guard finally recognizes you and knows the actual boundaries of the company.

items.original:
Fixed the tool confirmation dialog to accurately check normalized file URIs against active workspace directories, resolving an issue where valid in-workspace file creations and reads were incorrectly flagged with an `"Reason: outside workspace"` warning.
Fixed workspace initialization failures when launching the CLI inside dot-prefixed directories (such as  .parent_dir/project ) by scoping path exclusion filters strictly to relative paths inside the workspace rather than rejecting dot-prefixed ancestor directories.
Fixed the `/agents` panel's `"Create New Agents"` section displaying the wrong global configuration directory (`~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/` instead of `~/.gemini/config/`), ensuring users create global subagents in the location actively scanned during startup discovery.
Fixed the `/agents` view header displaying `agent.json` instead of `agent.md` when creating new subagents.

entries: Improved the `/tasks` detail panel to automatically scroll to the bottom as new background task logs stream in, and default to the latest output when opened while preserving scroll position if scrolled up manually.
Improved model generation resilience by adding automatic client-side retries when encountering transient errors.
Fixed dynamically defined subagents by transitioning definitions from JSON to Markdown format, fixing an issue where dynamically created subagents failed to invoke.
Fixed a crash occurring when executing background tasks or terminal commands that produce empty outputs (such as `sleep`).
Fixed shutdown resource leaks by integrating the shared SQLite summary store for background synchronization and resolving goroutine and database connection leaks on CLI exit.
Fixed a permission manager hook error by safely handling empty decision strings returned by pre-tool hooks instead of failing with an "unknown pre-tool hook decision" error.

title.zh-TW: 輸入框下方新增狀態列，一眼掌控所有在背景默默工作的助手
title.en: New real-time status bar showing all subagents working in the background
