Added fuzzy and partial substring matching across slash commands. E.g. `/el` -> shows `/help` and `/model` while previous no suggested completions.
Fixed a bug when suggestion was not triggered when `@` is typed after `(`. Enabled unconditional typeahead suggestions whenever `@` is typed without preceding whitespace, streamlining mention workflows.
Fixed a bug where entering a prompt immediately after pressing `Esc` (to interrupt an active agent stream) caused the newly typed input to be swallowed or rejected.

title.zh-TW: 歷史清單不再被子代理洗版，狀態列與沙盒更可靠
title.en: Clean history lists, stacked status lines, and reliable headless sandboxing

body.zh-TW: 你的歷史對話清單現在乾淨多了。打開 /resume 時，系統會自動把子代理（背後自動跑的機器人）的對話紀錄隱藏起來，只專心留著你自己開的對話，不會再被洗版。如果你有自訂終端機底下的狀態列，現在可以透過設定把「官方預設狀態」跟你自己的「自訂狀態」上下疊在一起顯示，不用再面臨二選一的抉擇。對於進階使用者，當你使用不跳視窗的純文字模式（--print）時，加上 --sandbox 的安全隔離指令也終於能正確生效了。就像整理信箱，以前廣告信會把你的私人信件全部淹沒，現在系統幫你把機器人的信件自動過濾掉；而且你的辦公桌上現在可以同時放著公司的公用月曆和你自己的私人筆記本，兩個都能一眼看到。
body.en: Your conversation history list is now much cleaner. When you open /resume, the system automatically hides all subagent (background bots) conversations, focusing purely on the chats you explicitly started so your list doesn't get relentlessly spammed. If you customized the status line at the bottom of the terminal, you can now toggle a setting to vertically stack the "default official status" with your "custom status" together, so you don't have to choose one or the other. For advanced users, when running in the non-interactive text-only mode (--print), the --sandbox isolation flag will finally enforce its security boundaries correctly. Like organizing your inbox: spam and automated emails used to drown out your personal letters, but now the system filters out the robot mail for you; additionally, you can now keep both the corporate calendar and your personal notebook on your desk at the same time, seeing both at a glance.

items.original:
Skipped subagent conversations from `/resume`, keeping the standalone conversation picker focused purely on direct user initiated conversations.
Added a `stack_with_default` flag to the `statusLine` configuration to render both the default Antigravity status line and custom status line output vertically stacked.
Fixed `--sandbox` flag propagation in headless print mode (`-p` / `--print`), ensuring sandbox isolation is correctly enforced during non-interactive execution.

entries: Added `--model` to set model when launching CLI. Also a new `models` subcommand to list available models.
Added `/permissions` command which allows to add/edit/remove permissions rules for each of the three configs above directly inside the CLI.
Allowed opening the Artifact Review panel (shortcut `ctrl+r`) while answering pending questions or tool permission confirmations, preserving your current progress when toggling back.
Fixed a bug that metadata was written in the current directory as opposed to `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/cache` when running using `-p`.
Improved statusline layout by merging active tip and artifact status on a single line and truncating with ellipsis on narrow terminals to prevent collisions.
Improved customization support by allowing directories in the customization manager to be passed as workspace directories, enabling correct trajectory metadata population and `/add-dir` support.
Added support for `url` in `mcp_config.json` to configure MCP servers directly via a URL.
Improved `/resume` performance: optimized lazy loading of conversation details, filtered out empty conversations, and added support for scanning SQLite database files (`.db` and `.db-wal`).
Improved autocomplete: tab completion for slash commands now resolves to the matched alias instead of the primary command name (e.g., `/se` autocompletes to `/settings` instead of `/config`).

Integrated the permissioning system with the rest of Antigravity. CLI permissions now merges project level permissions, permissions from user settings shared with Antigravity, and permissions from the CLI `settings.json`.

title.zh-TW: 權限管理更統一，還能在終端機裡直接修改
title.en: Unified permissions management with in-app editing and model launch flags

body.zh-TW: 管理系統權限變得更輕鬆了。現在終端機會把「專案專屬權限」、「你和其他 Antigravity 系統共用的設定」以及「CLI 自己的設定檔」這三邊的權限規則聰明地合併在一起，讓你不用再到處找設定檔。而且我們加了全新的 /permissions 指令，讓你直接在終端機裡面就能新增、修改或刪除這些權限規則，超級方便。在啟動軟體時，你現在也能直接加上 --model 參數來指定你想用的 AI 模型，甚至可以用新的 models 指令來查看有哪些模型可以選。就像大樓的保全系統，以前你要分別去三個不同的櫃檯設定門禁卡，現在全部連線同步了，而且你只要在大廳的觸控螢幕上點兩下，就能直接幫訪客開門。
body.en: Managing system permissions is now a breeze. The terminal intelligently merges your "project-specific permissions," "settings shared with the rest of Antigravity," and the "CLI's own config file" into one unified rule set, saving you from hunting down various config files. We've also added a brand-new /permissions command, allowing you to easily add, edit, or remove these rules directly inside the terminal. When launching the software, you can now instantly select your preferred AI model by adding the --model flag, or use the new models subcommand to see a list of all available options. Like a building's security system: you used to have to visit three different desks to set up an access card, but now everything is synchronized, and you can just tap the lobby's touchscreen a few times to let a guest in.

items.original:
Added `--model` to set model when launching CLI. Also a new `models` subcommand to list available models.
Added `/permissions` command which allows to add/edit/remove permissions rules for each of the three configs above directly inside the CLI.
Integrated the permissioning system with the rest of Antigravity. CLI permissions now merges project level permissions, permissions from user settings shared with Antigravity, and permissions from the CLI `settings.json`.

title.zh-TW: 審閱程式碼不卡關，畫面排版與補齊更貼心
title.en: Uninterrupted code review, cleaner status lines, and smarter autocomplete

body.zh-TW: 現在你的操作流程會順暢很多。以前如果系統問你要不要放行某個指令，或者正等著你回答問題時，你就沒辦法點開「產出審閱（Artifact Review）」面板去看程式碼；現在你隨時可以按 ctrl+r 切過去看，看完切回來時原本的進度都還在，不用被迫先回答盲猜。畫面底下的狀態列也重新排版了，提示訊息和產出狀態會併成一行顯示，就算你的視窗拉得很窄，文字也會優雅地用「...」省略，不會再擠成一團破圖。在使用快捷指令時，如果你打了縮寫（例如 /se），按 Tab 鍵補齊時它會乖乖補成你想要的 /settings，不會再雞婆地硬幫你換成它背後的本名 /config。就像你在填問卷填到一半時，以前不能離開座位去翻書確認答案，現在你可以隨時去查資料，回來時寫到一半的字都還在，而且服務生也不會再亂糾正你的發音了。
body.en: Your workflow is about to become much smoother. Previously, if the system asked you to approve a command or was waiting for you to answer a question, you were blocked from opening the "Artifact Review" panel to look at the code; now, you can press ctrl+r at any time to switch over and check, and when you switch back, your progress is perfectly preserved so you never have to blindly guess. The status line at the bottom of the screen has also been redesigned: active tips and artifact statuses now merge into a single line, and if your window is narrow, the text gracefully truncates with an ellipsis (...) instead of crushing the layout into a mess. When using slash commands, if you type an abbreviation (like /se), hitting Tab will obediently autocomplete it to the alias you wanted (/settings), rather than obnoxiously replacing it with its underlying primary name (/config). Like filling out a questionnaire: you used to be forbidden from leaving your seat to double-check a book for the answer, but now you can get up to do research anytime, and when you return, your half-written answers are exactly where you left them—and the waiter will no longer rudely "correct" your pronunciation.

items.original:
Allowed opening the Artifact Review panel (shortcut `ctrl+r`) while answering pending questions or tool permission confirmations, preserving your current progress when toggling back.
Improved statusline layout by merging active tip and artifact status on a single line and truncating with ellipsis on narrow terminals to prevent collisions.
Improved autocomplete: tab completion for slash commands now resolves to the matched alias instead of the primary command name (e.g., `/se` autocompletes to `/settings` instead of `/config`).

title.zh-TW: 歷史紀錄支援資料庫，快取與外掛工具設定修復
title.en: SQLite support for history, fixed cache locations, and direct MCP URLs

body.zh-TW: `/resume` 不再顯示空對話、也能掃描 SQLite 資料庫。打開 /resume 找歷史紀錄時，現在不會再跑出一堆沒有內容的空對話來擾亂你，載入速度也變快了，甚至還學會了掃描 SQLite 資料庫檔（.db），讓你找資料更全面。如果你用純文字的無頭模式（-p）執行，系統現在會乖乖把暫存資料（快取）寫進專用的 ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/cache 資料夾裡，不會再隨地大小便，弄髒你當下的工作目錄。在設定外部 MCP 伺服器工具時，現在可以直接在設定檔裡填寫 url 來連線，不用再繞遠路。如果你有自訂工具資料夾，現在它們也能被當成正常的工作區來對待了。就像買了更聰明的吸塵器，以前它會把空袋子也當成垃圾收集起來，還會把吸出來的灰塵隨地亂倒，現在它不但能精準過濾空袋子，還能直接接上網路管線，把灰塵準確地倒進專屬的垃圾桶裡。
body.en: We've exorcised a few details where the devil was hiding. When opening /resume to browse your history, the list now filters out entirely empty conversations that used to clutter the view, loads details much faster, and even learned how to scan SQLite database files (.db and .db-wal) to give you a more comprehensive view. If you run the tool in text-only headless mode (-p), it now obediently writes its temporary cache data into the dedicated ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/cache folder instead of treating your current working directory like a litter box. When configuring external MCP server tools, you can now connect directly by placing a URL in the config file, skipping unnecessary detours. Finally, if you manage custom tool directories, they can now properly be treated as functional workspace directories. Like buying a smarter vacuum cleaner: it used to collect empty wrappers while dumping the dust it sucked up all over your living room rug; now, it filters out the useless wrappers perfectly, plugs directly into your network pipe, and dumps the dirt precisely into its designated trash bin.

items.original:
Fixed a bug that metadata was written in the current directory as opposed to `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/cache` when running using `-p`.
Improved `/resume` performance: optimized lazy loading of conversation details, filtered out empty conversations, and added support for scanning SQLite database files (`.db` and `.db-wal`).
Improved customization support by allowing directories in the customization manager to be passed as workspace directories, enabling correct trajectory metadata population and `/add-dir` support.
Added support for `url` in `mcp_config.json` to configure MCP servers directly via a URL.

entries: Added SQLite (.db) conversation support and will be CLI’s conversation format. Fixed a bug when importing SQLite conversation from Antigravity 2.0 to CLI.

Added LaTeX math rendering, enabling the CLI to display beautiful mathematical formulas directly in the terminal viewport. Set `AGY_CLI_DISABLE_LATEX` environment variable to turn off LaTeX rendering globally if desired.

Decoupled project discovery from local `.antigravitycli` workspace directories. The CLI now stores workspace-to-project mappings in a centralized `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/cache/projects.json` file, eliminating repository clutter and speeding up project discovery to a single-map lookup.
Resolved sporadic and permanent UI hangs caused by a stateful callback streamer race condition during network drops or extremely fast agent steps.
Collapses all newlines and consecutive whitespaces in conversation previews and titles before rendering list items, preventing visual UI layout breaks in the picker rows.

Styled the separator space between the line number column and diff content to match the text blocks, ensuring background highlights stretch seamlessly across the viewport width in tool outputs and `/diff` details.

Resolved inconsistent behavior where selecting skill-derived slash commands from autocompletion suggestions cleared the input without executing. Autocompleted skill commands are now correctly submitted to the backend.

Aligned the interactive `/changelog` and `agy changelog` cache paths to both use `antigravity-cli`, and made the caching process synchronous to resolve a race condition where immediate process exit terminated the cache write.
Moved VCS detection out of the synchronous CLI startup path to prevent slow initialization.
Resolved an issue where exclusion rules and allowlists configured in rules.json were silently ignored, causing the discovery engine to load every .md rule file unconditionally at boot.

Parallelized the MCP server initialization sequence, preventing slow or hanging custom MCP servers from blocking independent, fast-starting servers (like local plugins) from loading on startup or configuration reloads.

title.zh-TW: 啟動神速不留垃圾，對話紀錄全面擁抱資料庫
title.en: Fast startup with zero repository clutter and full SQLite database support

body.zh-TW: 程式啟動速度變快了，而且也不會再亂製造垃圾檔案。以前系統會在你每個專案資料夾裡塞一個隱藏的 .antigravitycli 檔案來記住專案，不但礙眼還拖慢搜尋速度；現在它改把這些紀錄集中收在一個快取檔裡，專案資料夾終於乾淨了。同時，像「檢查 Git 版本控制」或「載入外部工具（MCP 伺服器）」這些本來很耗時的啟動步驟，現在都改到背景平行處理了，就算某個工具連線卡住，也不會害你連打字視窗都開不了。另外，終端機的對話紀錄正式改用 SQLite 資料庫格式（.db）儲存，如果你之前有從 Antigravity 2.0 匯入對話失敗的毛病，現在也都修好了。就像家裡的玄關，以前你要把所有鞋子擺出來慢慢挑才能出門，現在都收進隱藏的鞋櫃裡，而且警衛幫你開門跟司機發動車子是同時進行的，不再需要傻傻排隊等。
body.en: Program startup is much faster now, and it no longer litters your projects with junk files. Previously, the system would drop a hidden .antigravitycli file in every project folder to remember it, which cluttered your repository and slowed down discovery; it now stores these mappings centrally in a single cache file, leaving your project folders perfectly clean. At the same time, time-consuming startup steps like checking Git (VCS) or loading external tools (MCP servers) have been moved to parallel background processes—so even if one custom tool hangs, it won't block you from opening the chat window to start typing. Additionally, terminal conversations now officially use the SQLite database format (.db), and the bug that previously failed to import your chats from Antigravity 2.0 has been fixed. Like your home's entryway: you used to have to leave all your shoes scattered out to find a pair before leaving, but now they're neatly organized in a hidden cabinet; plus, the guard opening the gate and the driver starting the car now happen simultaneously instead of waiting in line.

items.original:
Added SQLite (.db) conversation support and will be CLI’s conversation format. Fixed a bug when importing SQLite conversation from Antigravity 2.0 to CLI.
Decoupled project discovery from local `.antigravitycli` workspace directories. The CLI now stores workspace-to-project mappings in a centralized `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/cache/projects.json` file, eliminating repository clutter and speeding up project discovery to a single-map lookup.
Moved VCS detection out of the synchronous CLI startup path to prevent slow initialization.
Parallelized the MCP server initialization sequence, preventing slow or hanging custom MCP servers from blocking independent, fast-starting servers (like local plugins) from loading on startup or configuration reloads.

title.zh-TW: 數學公式漂漂亮亮，排版與反白更完美
title.en: Beautiful LaTeX math rendering and flawless UI layouts

body.zh-TW: 終端機現在看得懂也畫得出數學公式了。系統現在支援 LaTeX 數學語法渲染，不管是微積分還是複雜的矩陣公式，都能直接在終端機裡漂亮地印出來（如果你不喜歡，也可以用環境變數關掉它）。在看歷史對話清單時，如果對話標題裡面有奇怪的換行或一堆空白，系統現在會把它們壓平成一行，不會再把選單撐破。當你在看程式碼差異（/diff）時，以前行號跟程式碼中間會有一條尷尬的未上色縫隙，現在背景標示顏色會完美地橫跨整個畫面，不再有破綻。就像以前在終端機裡看數學公式只能看一堆看不懂的符號亂碼，現在就像在看排版精美的教科書；而且看螢光筆畫重點時，筆跡也不會在中途詭異地斷掉了。
body.en: The terminal can now understand and draw math formulas. The system fully supports LaTeX math rendering, meaning everything from calculus to complex matrices will print beautifully right in your terminal viewport (you can also turn this off globally with an environment variable if you prefer). When viewing your conversation history, if a chat title contains awkward line breaks or a ton of consecutive whitespace, the system flattens it into a single line so it doesn't break the menu layout. When viewing code differences (/diff), there used to be an awkward uncolored gap between the line numbers and the code; the background highlight now stretches seamlessly across the entire width of the screen, leaving no visual flaws. Like trying to read math equations in the terminal: you used to stare at an unreadable mess of symbols, but now it looks like a beautifully typeset textbook; and when using a highlighter to mark important lines, the ink no longer randomly skips a spot in the middle.

items.original:
Added LaTeX math rendering, enabling the CLI to display beautiful mathematical formulas directly in the terminal viewport. Set `AGY_CLI_DISABLE_LATEX` environment variable to turn off LaTeX rendering globally if desired.
Collapses all newlines and consecutive whitespaces in conversation previews and titles before rendering list items, preventing visual UI layout breaks in the picker rows.
Styled the separator space between the line number column and diff content to match the text blocks, ensuring background highlights stretch seamlessly across the viewport width in tool outputs and `/diff` details.

title.zh-TW: 解決卡死當機與規則不理人的問題
title.en: Fixes UI hangs, autocomplete execution bugs, and ignored rules

body.zh-TW: 網路不穩時介面不再卡死。以前網路不穩或代理跑太快時，畫面有時會直接卡死再也不動；現在修好了這個回呼（callback）的問題，不會再死當。如果你自己寫了快捷指令（skill），以前在選單裡按 Tab 鍵補齊後，它竟然會直接清空輸入框裝死不執行；現在補齊後終於會乖乖送出了。另外，以前你在 rules.json 裡設定了「哪些規則要忽略、哪些要白名單」，系統啟動時卻會當作沒看到，傻傻把所有規則都載入；現在它終於學會聽話照做了。還有 /changelog 指令寫入快取時因為太急著關閉程式而失敗的毛病也修好了。就像你去點餐，以前你照著菜單點隱藏菜色，店員卻直接把點菜單撕掉當沒聽到，或是你明文規定不吃的配菜廚師還是全加進去，現在這些荒唐的服務態度都已經糾正完畢了。
body.en: We've eradicated several bugs that made you want to smash your keyboard. Previously, if your network dropped or an agent ran extremely fast, the UI could completely freeze due to a stateful callback race condition; this has been resolved so it won't permanently hang anymore. If you wrote a custom slash command (skill), selecting it via Tab autocomplete used to inexplicably clear your input box and do absolutely nothing; it now properly submits to the backend. Also, if you configured allowlists or exclusion rules in rules.json, the system used to blindly ignore them on startup and load every rule anyway; it has finally learned to follow your instructions. A bug where the /changelog cache failed to save because the program exited too quickly has also been fixed. Like ordering at a restaurant: you used to order a secret menu item, but the waiter would just rip up your ticket and play dumb, or the chef would toss in the exact ingredients you explicitly asked to exclude; these ridiculous service issues have finally been corrected.

items.original:
Resolved sporadic and permanent UI hangs caused by a stateful callback streamer race condition during network drops or extremely fast agent steps.
Resolved inconsistent behavior where selecting skill-derived slash commands from autocompletion suggestions cleared the input without executing. Autocompleted skill commands are now correctly submitted to the backend.
Aligned the interactive `/changelog` and `agy changelog` cache paths to both use `antigravity-cli`, and made the caching process synchronous to resolve a race condition where immediate process exit terminated the cache write.
Resolved an issue where exclusion rules and allowlists configured in rules.json were silently ignored, causing the discovery engine to load every .md rule file unconditionally at boot.

entries: Added support for G1 credits in the Antigravity CLI. Users can now utilize G1 credits when their standard quota runs out. This includes a new `UseG1Credits` setting to enable automatic credit usage and a real-time display of remaining credits in the status bar.
Added a new `/credits` panel that provides an in-CLI interface with a direct link to purchase additional G1 credits.
Fixed an infinite loop in the prompt input. Navigating left (`wordLeft`) when encountering spaces at the very beginning of the input no longer causes an infinite hang.

Fixed custom MCP server disabling via the TUI. Resolved a directory path mismatch where pressing the `[Disable]` button wrote to the legacy `mcp_config.json` path instead of the migrated `config/mcp_config.json` path, ensuring custom MCP servers can now be successfully disabled and unloaded.
Redesign CLI logo on Apple Terminal.
Improved color scheme preview in settings and onboarding: added warnings and thought process examples to the preview, and corrected link styling to only underline the URL.

title.zh-TW: 額度用完不用怕，全新 G1 點數支援上線
title.en: Never run out of quota: G1 credits support is now live

body.zh-TW: 當你的標準額度用光時，不用再苦苦等待了。系統現在正式支援「G1 點數（G1 credits）」，並推出全新的 UseG1Credits 設定，只要開啟它，當標準額度耗盡時，系統就會自動扣點數讓你繼續使用。你可以在畫面底下的狀態列即時看到還剩多少點數，也可以用全新的 /credits 指令打開點數面板，甚至能直接在裡面點擊連結購買充值。就像你手機的網路流量用完時，以前只能被迫斷網等下個月，現在系統會自動幫你用預付卡扣款繼續飆網，而且隨時能查餘額跟儲值。
body.en: You no longer have to wait agonizingly when your standard quota runs out. The system now officially supports "G1 credits" and introduces a new UseG1Credits setting; when enabled, it seamlessly starts using your credits the moment your standard quota is depleted. You can monitor your remaining credits in real-time right on the bottom status bar, use the brand-new /credits command to open a dedicated panel, and even click a direct link within it to purchase more. Like running out of your phone's monthly data plan: you used to get cut off from the internet and forced to wait for the next month, but now the system automatically taps into a prepaid card to keep you surfing at full speed, letting you check your balance and top up with a single click.

items.original:
Added support for G1 credits in the Antigravity CLI. Users can now utilize G1 credits when their standard quota runs out. This includes a new `UseG1Credits` setting to enable automatic credit usage and a real-time display of remaining credits in the status bar.
Added a new `/credits` panel that provides an in-CLI interface with a direct link to purchase additional G1 credits.

title.zh-TW: 畫面排版更精緻，多題問卷不再忘記答案
title.en: Refined layouts and UI dialogs that remember your answers

body.zh-TW: 長程式碼差異會依視窗寬度換行。如果你是用蘋果的終端機（Apple Terminal），現在會看到全新設計的標誌。在挑選或設定程式的主題顏色時，預覽畫面變得更真實了，會把「警告訊息」和「思考過程」的顏色也秀給你參考，網址底線也不會再亂畫。當你在看程式碼差異（/diff）時，如果文字太長，現在它會聰明地根據你的視窗大小自動換行，不會再被卡掉一半。當系統連環問你問題時（例如設定精靈），如果你按左鍵想回到上一題修改，以前它會把你剛剛辛辛苦苦打的答案跟選項忘得一乾二淨，現在它終於學會記住你的作答進度了。就像你在填線上表單，以前按了「上一頁」填好的資料就會全部消失重來，現在系統會貼心地幫你把寫到一半的字都保留著。
body.en: We've made several thoughtful tweaks to the visual layout. If you use Apple Terminal, you'll now be greeted by a newly redesigned logo. When previewing or setting the application's color theme, the preview is much more realistic, now including samples for "warnings" and "thought processes," and fixing an issue where URL underlines were drawn haphazardly. When viewing code differences (/diff), if a line is too long, it now smartly wraps text based on your window size instead of cutting it off completely. When the system asks you a sequence of questions (like in a setup wizard) and you press the left arrow to go back and change a previous answer, it used to completely suffer from amnesia and wipe out everything you had just painstakingly typed; it finally knows how to remember your progress. Like filling out an online form: hitting "back" used to delete all your entered data and force you to start over, but now the system thoughtfully preserves everything you've written so far.

title.zh-TW: 解決卡死、編輯器開不了與專案找不到的怪病
title.en: Fixes input hangs, editor launch failures, and fragile project discovery

body.zh-TW: 輸入框開頭按左移不再無限卡死。以前在輸入框打字時，如果你在最開頭的空白處按熱鍵往左跳，程式就會陷入死胡同無限當機，現在已經修好了。在終端機介面裡想關掉某個外部 MCP 工具時，以前按了「關閉」卻因為系統寫錯設定檔位置而關不掉，現在終於能確實把工具卸載了。如果你有自訂文字編輯器（像是在 $EDITOR 裡寫 --alternate-editor=vi），以前系統會因為不懂得處理等號而導致編輯器打不開，現在它看得懂了。另外，系統在尋找你的專案資料夾時，如果遇到壞掉的捷徑（symlink），以前會直接當機放棄尋找，現在它懂得自動跳過壞掉的捷徑，繼續找出其他正常的專案。就像你去巡房，以前只要遇到一扇壞掉打不開的門，你就會直接下班回家，現在你懂得繞過那扇門去檢查其他的房間了。
body.en: We've eradicated several highly confusing system bugs. Previously, when typing in the input box, if you hit the shortcut to jump left while at the very beginning of the blank space, the program would get trapped in an infinite loop and completely hang; this has been fixed. When trying to disable an external MCP tool from the terminal UI, clicking "Disable" used to do absolutely nothing because the system was writing to the wrong config file path; it now correctly unloads the tool. If you use a custom text editor with complex arguments (like --alternate-editor=vi in your $EDITOR variable), the system used to crash because it didn't know how to handle the equals sign; it parses it perfectly now. Additionally, when searching for your project folders, encountering a broken shortcut (symlink) used to make the system throw a tantrum and completely give up searching; it now smartly skips the broken links and continues finding your valid projects. Like a night guard doing rounds: previously, if one door was jammed, the guard would just go home and abandon the rest of the patrol, but now they know how to walk past the broken door and check the remaining rooms.

items.original:
Fixed an infinite loop in the prompt input. Navigating left (`wordLeft`) when encountering spaces at the very beginning of the input no longer causes an infinite hang.
Fixed custom MCP server disabling via the TUI. Resolved a directory path mismatch where pressing the `[Disable]` button wrote to the legacy `mcp_config.json` path instead of the migrated `config/mcp_config.json` path, ensuring custom MCP servers can now be successfully disabled and unloaded.
Fixed `$EDITOR` environment variable parsing: resolved issues where arguments containing `=` (e.g., `--alternate-editor=vi`) were incorrectly split, causing editor launch failures.
Fixed project discovery robustness: updated the CLI to skip invalid or broken symlinks in `.antigravitycli/` rather than failing immediately, allowing discovery of valid projects.

entries: Added `AGY_CLI_HIDE_ACCOUNT_INFO` environment variable to hide email and plan tier from the header.
Fixed timeout overrides: restricted the default 60-second interaction timeout specifically to subagents, preventing the main agent from being unconditionally capped.
Fixed a nil-pointer panic in Sandbox Mode: resolved a typed nil interface comparison when fetching URL content.

Fixed fallback skill discovery in Standalone mode: ensures custom/fallback skills are successfully loaded even if the standard configuration directory is missing, and added automatic path deduplication to prevent duplicates.
Fixed command rendering in message history: prefixed slash commands with a caret (`>`) in response block headers to clearly distinguish user-typed commands from agent outputs.

Fixed plugin installation path mismatch: updated the `plugin` subcommand to install downloaded plugins directly to the shared configuration directory (`~/.gemini/config/`) rather than the private application data folder, making them instantly discoverable.

Fixed Git short-hash support in diff selection: updated the commit hash recognition pattern in the  /diff  commit selection tree to match Git's standard 7-character short hashes (and up to 40-character full hashes).

Fixed statusline subcommand handling and recursive loops: added case-insensitive subcommand parsing (help, delete, reset, enable/on, disable/off) to the /statusline command, providing direct control to toggle or revert custom statuslines and blocking recursive shell hangs during help queries.

Improved `/help` shortcuts tab by sorting shortcuts by keybinding key, adding missing keybindings (like `ctrl+r`, `ctrl+o`, `alt+j`, `ctrl+k`), and generalizing scrolling (PageUp/PageDown/GoToTop/GoToBottom) for both Commands and Shortcuts tabs.

title.zh-TW: 畫面資訊更貼心，狀態列與說明選單升級
title.en: Cleaner UI with privacy options, robust statusline controls, and a better help menu

body.zh-TW: 終端機畫面現在更照顧你的隱私與閱讀體驗了。如果你不想讓別人在你背後偷看你的帳號信箱或方案等級，現在可以用 AGY_CLI_HIDE_ACCOUNT_INFO 參數把畫面頂部的這些私人資訊藏起來。在看歷史對話時，你自己打的快捷指令現在前面會多一個大於符號（>），讓你一眼分出哪句是你打的、哪段是 AI 講的。用 /statusline 自訂狀態列時也變得更聰明，現在它聽得懂開關與重設的指令（像 on/off 或 reset），而且不會再因為看說明文件而卡死。打開 /help 選單時，裡面的快捷鍵終於照著按鍵順序排好，也把漏掉的快捷鍵補上了，現在不管是看指令還是看快捷鍵，都可以順暢地整頁捲動。另外，當你用 /diff 想看某個特定的 Git 歷史版本時，它現在終於認得標準的 7 碼短代號了。就像你的辦公桌，以前抽屜亂七八糟、別人還能一眼看到你的薪水單，現在不但加上了密碼鎖，文件也分門別類排好，連標籤上的縮寫也能精準對應。
body.en: The terminal interface is now much more mindful of your privacy and reading experience. If you don't want someone looking over your shoulder to see your email address or subscription tier, you can use the AGY_CLI_HIDE_ACCOUNT_INFO environment variable to hide this private info from the top header. When reviewing message history, your typed slash commands are now prefixed with a caret (>), making it instantly obvious which lines you typed and which parts the AI generated. Customizing your status line with /statusline is also smarter now: it understands direct commands to toggle or reset it (like on/off or reset), and no longer hangs the program if you ask for help. When you open the /help menu, the shortcuts are finally sorted alphabetically, missing keys have been added, and you can now smoothly scroll through both the commands and shortcuts tabs using page-up/down keys. Finally, when using /diff to inspect a specific Git version, it now correctly recognizes standard 7-character short commit hashes. Like organizing your office desk: your drawers used to be a mess and anyone could see your pay stub lying around; now everything is locked up, documents are perfectly categorized, and even the shorthand labels are perfectly matched.

items.original:
Added `AGY_CLI_HIDE_ACCOUNT_INFO` environment variable to hide email and plan tier from the header.
Fixed command rendering in message history: prefixed slash commands with a caret (`>`) in response block headers to clearly distinguish user-typed commands from agent outputs.
Fixed statusline subcommand handling and recursive loops: added case-insensitive subcommand parsing (help, delete, reset, enable/on, disable/off) to the /statusline command, providing direct control to toggle or revert custom statuslines and blocking recursive shell hangs during help queries.
Improved `/help` shortcuts tab by sorting shortcuts by keybinding key, adding missing keybindings (like `ctrl+r`, `ctrl+o`, `alt+j`, `ctrl+k`), and generalizing scrolling (PageUp/PageDown/GoToTop/GoToBottom) for both Commands and Shortcuts tabs.
Fixed Git short-hash support in diff selection: updated the commit hash recognition pattern in the  /diff  commit selection tree to match Git's standard 7-character short hashes (and up to 40-character full hashes).

title.zh-TW: 解除 60 秒強迫斷線魔咒，外掛與技能不再迷路
title.en: Agent timeouts fixed, sandbox panics resolved, and plugins install correctly

body.zh-TW: 主代理不再被 60 秒互動逾時強制中斷。以前系統有一個預設的「60 秒互動超時」限制，本來是為了管教子代理不要掛網太久，結果不小心連主代理（你正在對話的對象）也被波及，導致它有時講話講到一半就被強制斷線；現在這個緊箍咒只會限制子代理了。在沙盒模式（sandbox）底下抓取網址內容時，系統不會再因為碰到空資料而當機。另外，外掛與技能的路徑也全數導正了：如果你安裝了新的外掛，它現在會乖乖住進共用的設定資料夾（~/.gemini/config/），讓你一裝完就能立刻用；即使在缺乏標準設定資料夾的獨立模式下執行，系統也能順利找到備用的技能檔案，並且不會重複載入。就像修理了一台老是不聽話的機器，以前煮飯超過 60 秒就會被強制斷電，買回來的新外掛也老是被丟進雜物間找不到，現在它不但能煮到熟，新買的配件也能一裝上就立刻發揮作用。
body.en: We've fixed a few underlying issues that were seriously holding the system back. Previously, there was a default "60-second interaction timeout" limit intended to keep background subagents from hanging indefinitely, but it accidentally affected the main agent (the one you chat with directly), sometimes brutally cutting it off mid-sentence; this strict collar now only applies to subagents. When fetching URL content in sandbox mode, the system will no longer crash if it encounters empty data. Additionally, plugin and skill paths have all been corrected: when you install a new plugin, it is now properly placed in the shared config folder (~/.gemini/config/) so it's instantly usable; and even when running in a standalone mode missing the standard config directory, the system can still successfully locate fallback skill files without loading them twice. Like fixing a constantly misbehaving appliance: it used to forcefully cut the power if it cooked for more than 60 seconds, and newly bought attachments would always get lost in the junk drawer; now, it cooks until it's done, and new attachments work perfectly the moment you plug them in.

items.original:
Fixed timeout overrides: restricted the default 60-second interaction timeout specifically to subagents, preventing the main agent from being unconditionally capped.
Fixed a nil-pointer panic in Sandbox Mode: resolved a typed nil interface comparison when fetching URL content.
Fixed fallback skill discovery in Standalone mode: ensures custom/fallback skills are successfully loaded even if the standard configuration directory is missing, and added automatic path deduplication to prevent duplicates.
Fixed plugin installation path mismatch: updated the `plugin` subcommand to install downloaded plugins directly to the shared configuration directory (`~/.gemini/config/`) rather than the private application data folder, making them instantly discoverable.

entries: Fixed OAuth token persistence and authentication hangs.

Fixed Windows log redirection and resizing issues. Resolved a critical bug where logs were not redirected correctly on Windows, which previously caused the terminal to swallow window resize events and shut down slowly.
Added `proceed-in-sandbox` tool permission mode. Auto-approves terminal commands that run inside the secure sandbox, requesting manual approval only when a command attempts to bypass the sandbox.
Integrates consumer/free-tier onboarding directly into the CLI.
Added plugin discovery for skills and agents. Automatically scans installed plugin directories to make custom skills and specialized agents available for execution in the CLI.

Fixed pasted text line counting. Corrected line counting for user inputs to ensure extremely long inputs are correctly folded into a `[Pasted text #X +Y lines]` placeholder to keep the viewport clean.
Fixed onboarding stability. Resolved a race condition where a concurrent terminal resize event during onboarding could revert the UI to a blank onboarding screen.
Moves the **terminal** color scheme to the top of the selection list, making it the default choice during onboarding and in `/settings`.
Improved `/usage` and `/quota` commands. Forces a real-time reload of model configuration and remaining quotas, allowing you to see updated real-time consumption statistics immediately.
Improved step rendering layout. Calculates available terminal width dynamically and uses middle-truncation (`/foo/.../bar`) for file path tools to prevent layout shifting on narrow screens.

Improved session deletion keybinding in `/resume`. Changed the shortcut from `ctrl+d` to `ctrl+delete` to resolve conflicts with the global exit keybinding (`ctrl+d` `ctrl+d`) and preserve Emacs-style forward-delete in search input fields.
Restored automatic table wrapping, preventing long cells inside markdown tables from being truncated.
Resolved an issue where deleted files (represented by `+++ /dev/null`) had their deletion lines incorrectly merged into the previous file's diff.

title.zh-TW: 歡迎畫面直接搞定免費帳號，黑白風格成預設首選
title.en: Built-in free-tier onboarding and stable terminal themes

body.zh-TW: 新玩家加入變得更容易了。現在你剛打開軟體時，可以直接在終端機裡順暢完成免費帳號的註冊與綁定（onboarding），不用再四處找教學。在挑選顏色主題時，最經典、和系統環境最搭的「terminal（黑白終端機）」風格現在被移到了最上面，成為預設首選。以前如果你在註冊畫面上手癢拉了一下視窗大小，畫面可能會因為來不及反應而變成一片空白當機，現在這個脆弱的問題也修好了。就像搬進新家，以前要自己去不同部門辦水電，現在大廳就有專人幫你辦到好，而且預設附贈的傢俱就已經是最百搭的款式，不用怕選錯，而且調整擺設時房子也不會再突然停電了。
body.en: Getting started as a new user is now much easier. When you open the software for the first time, you can now smoothly complete the free-tier account registration and onboarding directly within the terminal, without needing to hunt down tutorials elsewhere. When picking a color theme, the classic, environment-matching "terminal" (black & white) style has been moved to the very top, making it the default choice. Previously, if you resized your window while on the onboarding screen, the UI would fail to react in time and crash into a blank screen; this fragility has been fixed. Like moving into a new apartment: you used to have to visit different municipal offices to set up your utilities, but now the lobby concierge handles it all for you; plus, the default furniture provided is the most versatile style, so you can't go wrong, and rearranging it won't suddenly cause a power outage anymore.

Integrates consumer/free-tier onboarding directly into the CLI.

title.zh-TW: 排版不走鐘，表格、長檔名與刪除紀錄的按鍵都調整好了
title.en: Flawless layouts for tables and paths, plus safe session deletion

body.zh-TW: 畫面排版變得更加堅固且順眼。以前貼上超級長的文章時，行數計算會出錯，導致畫面又被撐爆；現在系統會精準把它折疊成短短一行「貼上的文字」提示框。當 AI 正在讀取某個資料夾深處的檔案時，如果路徑太長，現在它會聰明地把中間省略成「/foo/.../bar」，確保不會把原本的排版擠歪。用 Markdown 畫表格時，裡面很長的字現在終於會自動換行，不會再硬生生被切斷了。在看程式碼差異時，被刪除的檔案也不會再跟上一個檔案的內容詭異地黏在一起。另外，在 /resume 歷史清單裡刪除對話的快捷鍵，從容易誤按的 ctrl+d 改成了 ctrl+delete，這樣就不會跟你平常想刪字或退出程式的習慣打架了。就像排版一本雜誌，以前字太長就會凸出格子、被刪除的圖會殘留在上一頁，現在所有文字跟圖片都完美待在它們該待的格子裡。
body.en: The interface layout is now much more robust and pleasing to the eye. Previously, pasting an incredibly long article would mess up the line counting and blow up the screen; now, the system accurately folds it into a short "[Pasted text]" placeholder. When the AI is reading a file buried deep in a folder, if the path is too long, it now smartly truncates the middle into "/foo/.../bar" to ensure the layout doesn't shift. Long text inside Markdown tables will now automatically wrap instead of being abruptly cut off. When viewing code differences, deleted files will no longer bizarrely merge their content into the previous file's diff block. Additionally, the shortcut for deleting a conversation in the /resume history list has been changed from the accident-prone ctrl+d to ctrl+delete, so it won't clash with your muscle memory for forward-deleting text or exiting the program. Like typesetting a magazine: text used to spill out of its boxes and deleted images would leave ghost traces on the previous page, but now every word and picture stays perfectly inside its designated bounds.

items.original:
Fixed pasted text line counting. Corrected line counting for user inputs to ensure extremely long inputs are correctly folded into a `[Pasted text #X +Y lines]` placeholder to keep the viewport clean.
Improved step rendering layout. Calculates available terminal width dynamically and uses middle-truncation (`/foo/.../bar`) for file path tools to prevent layout shifting on narrow screens.
Improved session deletion keybinding in `/resume`. Changed the shortcut from `ctrl+d` to `ctrl+delete` to resolve conflicts with the global exit keybinding (`ctrl+d` `ctrl+d`) and preserve Emacs-style forward-delete in search input fields.

title.zh-TW: 沙盒指令自動放行，查詢額度不再慢半拍
title.en: Auto-approve sandbox commands, real-time quotas, and instant plugin discovery

body.zh-TW: 沙盒內指令可少按同意。我們推出了一種全新的「在沙盒中繼續執行」的權限模式：只要指令是在安全的沙盒（sandbox，隔離的安全區）裡面跑，系統就會自動幫你點頭放行，只有遇到想越界逃出沙盒的危險指令才會停下來問你，讓你少按很多次「同意」。用 /usage 查額度時，系統現在會強制即時向伺服器更新，讓你立刻看到最準確的消耗量，不用再等它慢慢同步。外掛系統也升級了，現在會自動掃描你安裝的外掛目錄，一裝好就能直接在終端機裡呼叫自訂的技能跟代理。對於 Windows 系統的使用者，以前日誌（log）沒寫好會導致視窗大小卡住而且關閉超慢，現在也順利解決了，就像有了個聰明的門禁系統，以後在安全區裡活動的員工都不用再查證件，而且你的點數卡餘額一刷就會立刻更新，不用等到隔天才扣款。
body.en: Permission management and the underlying system are much smarter now. We've introduced a brand-new "proceed-in-sandbox" permission mode: as long as a command is running safely isolated inside the sandbox, the system will auto-approve it for you, only stopping to ask for your permission if a dangerous command attempts to break out, saving you from clicking "Approve" constantly. When you use /usage to check your quota, the system now forcefully reloads data from the server in real-time, giving you immediately accurate consumption stats instead of making you wait for a slow sync. The plugin system has also been upgraded: it automatically scans your installed plugin directories, meaning you can call your custom skills and agents directly in the terminal the moment they are installed. For Windows users, a critical bug where poorly handled logs caused window resizing to freeze and made the app shut down excruciatingly slowly has been fixed. Like installing a smart security gate: employees moving within the designated safe zone no longer have to show ID at every corner, and when you swipe your prepaid card, the balance updates instantly instead of taking until the next day to process.

items.original:
Added `proceed-in-sandbox` tool permission mode. Auto-approves terminal commands that run inside the secure sandbox, requesting manual approval only when a command attempts to bypass the sandbox.
Improved `/usage` and `/quota` commands. Forces a real-time reload of model configuration and remaining quotas, allowing you to see updated real-time consumption statistics immediately.
Added plugin discovery for skills and agents. Automatically scans installed plugin directories to make custom skills and specialized agents available for execution in the CLI.
Fixed Windows log redirection and resizing issues. Resolved a critical bug where logs were not redirected correctly on Windows, which previously caused the terminal to swallow window resize events and shut down slowly.
